programme.desc: 本集輪到卓嵐、Kyle和Eunice組隊購物。迷路的時候，最怕一個講東，一個講西。在意見不同的情況下，三人如何協調？到最後，誰才是真正豬隊友？！最後輪到新一、Migal和小善組隊出發，平常看似自信滿滿的三人組，竟然在購物過程中頻頻碰壁，究竟自信是否總是好事.

programme.title: 文藝誌
programme.desc: 「藝術」兩個字，意義卻有千百種解釋，總給予人「離地」的感覺。為了令藝術的形象「貼地」，節目「踩場」到不同的文藝團體，透過「傾閒偈」，並互動「過招」，幫觀眾了解該藝團的有趣好玩之處。同時，節目會拜見最新穎到最傳統的藝團，探索出文藝的脈絡，幫大家對「文藝」二字下新定義.

programme.title: 島嶼協奏曲
programme.desc: Lydia跟Leo送別了傑傑，剩下二人好好面對這幾年下來的心結，二人回想起當初希望來到綠島的初心。對比著期待和現實的落差，夫婦二人嘗試尋求共識。居留證即將到期，Yvonne久違地回到香港，與最想逃避的母親見面。Faye也作了一個新的決定，出發去找那個願意接受她一切的人。他們各自都在旅途上邊走邊看或偶爾泊岸，然後，再往下一段旅程出發.

programme.title: 德國寶入伙專家呈獻: 百次的回憶
programme.desc: 鍾熙發現是媽媽害煐禮失去工作。與此同時，才弼正視了自己對煐禮的感情。蜜雪兒建議煐禮參加韓國小姐選美比賽。煐禮雖然有很多顧慮，但在家人和朋友的支持下，她決定參加比賽。鍾熙聽到這個消息後也決定參加.

programme.title: UA 亞洲聯合財務呈獻: IT狗2.0
programme.desc: PPD正式上市，氣勢如虹，國際巨星即將訪港，PPD成功爭取其演唱會獨家代理權，蒙玲提議在剛落成的元宇宙開騷，阿信卻迂迴反對⋯Tony私會「世仇」一事敗露，被狂怒的Cindy和大台教信眾禁錮進行驅魔儀式！阿信巧遇重開頹麵店的Lou，開始感受到成功後的孤獨與空虛。AI George的智能發展一日千里，眾人盼他能破解黎曼猜想，此時卻出現亂碼.....

programme.title: 百日女團
programme.desc: 調整失落心情之後，Shirley、Asha繼續為PAWS嘅出道造勢！適逢情人節同農曆新年，PAWS再次落區同粉絲近距離互動。第一站 -- 維園年宵！走入最熱鬧最多人嘅年宵花市大派PAWS限定揮春、風車同利是封，同大家拜個早年！情人節探訪浪漫聖地西九海濱，為有情人送上熱情紅玫瑰。其後Asha以特別嘅馬年造型，單拖排十個鐘隊只為插頭炷香，向黃大仙祈求Showcase一切順利，但整個過程既驚又喜⋯.

programme.title: 晚吹 - 男人亂講嘢
programme.desc: 節目介紹\n男人該如何面對覺醒（WOKE）的美好新世界？ 為紓緩廣大男士焦慮和不安，193、阿Thor、灘叔，每星期都會同你圍爐亂講一通，一齊笑著尋找當下世界觀、刷新固有價值觀、重塑男人三十、四十、五十路人生觀！唔係要話人知男人曾經有幾威，而係要居安思危、探討家下男人有幾閉翳.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度

programme.title: 天空城堡
programme.desc: 在天空城堡舉辦的生日會上，主角未久從高處墮下。他失去知覺，情況危急，被送往帝都醫院。同時，警方考慮到這可能是一宗事故，開始進行調查.

programme.title: 月亮在江邊流淌
programme.desc: 講述失去笑容的朝鮮王世子，擁有冷峻氣質與壓倒性的氣場，背負着喪失摯愛與朝廷鬥爭的傷痛。以及樂觀開朗的女攤販，雖然失去部分過去記憶，仍堅強面對生活。在某日二人意外靈魂互換，進而展開對自身與他人命運的重新審視，並因靈魂互換而展開浪漫奇幻愛情故事.

programme.title: Numbers：大廈之林的監視者們
programme.desc: 高中畢業出身會計師張浩宇面對大型會計師事務所的不正之風，以最不像會計師的方式實現正義.

programme.title: 奇蹟的兄弟
programme.desc: 講述一位懷抱著成為名作家夢想的志願生，雖然父親期望他成為像「尹東柱」這樣的劃時代詩人而取名，但現實是只有一身債務的作家志願生陸東柱，和來歷不明、有著特殊能力的少年姜山超越時間的界限一起尋找真相並創造奇蹟的過程.

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 故事描述已經脫離工作職場長達7年，以實習生回歸的40多歲女性重投社會工作，在這個像叢林般危險的職場中堅持著、硬撐著生存下去的故事.

programme.title: 許我耀眼
programme.desc: 當紅主播許妍（趙露思飾）和都會精英沈皓明（陳偉霆飾）是一對人人艷羨慕的夫妻，看似十分般配的兩人，由於出生環境的差異，始終難以融入對方的圈子。許妍靠著光鮮的主持人身分和「精心裝點」的身世順利和沈皓明步入婚姻，而這一切盡在沈皓明的掌握下。衝突來臨，許妍脫離沈皓明的掌控一去不回頭。沈皓明卻發現自己早已陷入愛情，想要全力追回許妍。經歷種種，兩人終於撕掉外表的偽裝，重新靠近，會見彼此的內在，也重新認識自己.

programme.desc: 故事描述已經脫離工作職場長達7年，以實習生回歸的40多歲女性重投社會工作，在這個像叢林般危險的職場中堅持著、硬撐著生存下去的故事.

programme.title: 許我耀眼
programme.desc: 當紅主播許妍（趙露思飾）和都會精英沈皓明（陳偉霆飾）是一對人人艷羨慕的夫妻，看似十分般配的兩人，由於出生環境的差異，始終難以融入對方的圈子。許妍靠著光鮮的主持人身分和「精心裝點」的身世順利和沈皓明步入婚姻，而這一切盡在沈皓明的掌握下。衝突來臨，許妍脫離沈皓明的掌控一去不回頭。沈皓明卻發現自己早已陷入愛情，想要全力追回許妍。經歷種種，兩人終於撕掉外表的偽裝，重新靠近，會見彼此的內在，也重新認識自己.

programme.title: 月亮在江邊流淌
programme.desc: 講述失去笑容的朝鮮王世子，擁有冷峻氣質與壓倒性的氣場，背負着喪失摯愛與朝廷鬥爭的傷痛。以及樂觀開朗的女攤販，雖然失去部分過去記憶，仍堅強面對生活。在某日二人意外靈魂互換，進而展開對自身與他人命運的重新審視，並因靈魂互換而展開浪漫奇幻愛情故事.

programme.title: 奇蹟的兄弟

programme.desc: 講述失去笑容的朝鮮王世子，擁有冷峻氣質與壓倒性的氣場，背負着喪失摯愛與朝廷鬥爭的傷痛。以及樂觀開朗的女攤販，雖然失去部分過去記憶，仍堅強面對生活。在某日二人意外靈魂互換，進而展開對自身與他人命運的重新審視，並因靈魂互換而展開浪漫奇幻愛情故事.

programme.title: Numbers：大廈之林的監視者們

programme.title: 仙女榴槤
programme.desc: 二百年後兩個神祕的女人，突然出現在超級富有的丹氏家族，沒人知道她們是誰。但隨後這兩位女子意識到，在前世她們與丹氏家族的每位成員，都有着密不可分的關係.

programme.desc: 當紅主播許妍（趙露思飾）和都會精英沈皓明（陳偉霆飾）是一對人人艷羨慕的夫妻，看似十分般配的兩人，由於出生環境的差異，始終難以融入對方的圈子。許妍靠著光鮮的主持人身分和「精心裝點」的身世順利和沈皓明步入婚姻，而這一切盡在沈皓明的掌握下。衝突來臨，許妍脫離沈皓明的掌控一去不回頭。沈皓明卻發現自己早已陷入愛情，想要全力追回許妍。經歷種種，兩人終於撕掉外表的偽裝，重新靠近，會見彼此的內在，也重新認識自己.

programme.title: 月亮在江邊流淌
programme.desc: 講述失去笑容的朝鮮王世子，擁有冷峻氣質與壓倒性的氣場，背負着喪失摯愛與朝廷鬥爭的傷痛。以及樂觀開朗的女攤販，雖然失去部分過去記憶，仍堅強面對生活。在某日二人意外靈魂互換，進而展開對自身與他人命運的重新審視，並因靈魂互換而展開浪漫奇幻愛情故事.

programme.title: Numbers：大廈之林的監視者們
programme.desc: 高中畢業出身會計師張浩宇面對大型會計師事務所的不正之風，以最不像會計師的方式實現正義.

programme.title: 仙女榴槤
programme.desc: 二百年後兩個神祕的女人，突然出現在超級富有的丹氏家族，沒人知道她們是誰。但隨後這兩位女子意識到，在前世她們與丹氏家族的每位成員，都有着密不可分的關係.

programme.title: 美女與純情男
programme.desc: 此劇敘述年幼便出道養家的一線女演員與PD的愛情故事。女演員因母親賭博的債務及醜聞一夜之間跌落谷底。PD嘗試鼓勵她重新振作，女演員卻消失了….

programme.title: 許我耀眼
programme.desc: 當紅主播許妍（趙露思飾）和都會精英沈皓明（陳偉霆飾）是一對人人艷羨慕的夫妻，看似十分般配的兩人，由於出生環境的差異，始終難以融入對方的圈子。許妍靠著光鮮的主持人身分和「精心裝點」的身世順利和沈皓明步入婚姻，而這一切盡在沈皓明的掌握下。衝突來臨，許妍脫離沈皓明的掌控一去不回頭。沈皓明卻發現自己早已陷入愛情，想要全力追回許妍。經歷種種，兩人終於撕掉外表的偽裝，重新靠近，會見彼此的內在，也重新認識自己.

programme.title: 警視廳臥底調查室
programme.desc: 以日本尚未制度化的臥底誘捕調查為主題，森川葵在劇中飾演的是警視廳新設立小隊「STINGERS（臥底搜查檢證室）」的隊長——二階堂民子。她是警察廳的菁英份子，曾赴美接受 FBI 的正統「Sting Operation（臥底行動）」訓練，身為頂尖精英警視歸國。擅長偽裝、即興演技、心理操控與陷阱設計，是臥底搜查的專家。說話簡潔、指示神秘，經常以出人意表的行動讓部下摸不著頭緒，卻又總能在不知不覺間讓一切線索串連起來。這位充滿謎團的領導者，將帶領 STINGERS 成功解決各種案件.

programme.title: 米之女 ─國稅局資料調查課・雜國室─
programme.desc: 日本國稅局「米」課，是令逃稅者聞風喪膽的最終防線。在其內部，新設了一個原創部門——複雜國稅案件處理室「雜國室」。由米田正子（松嶋菜菜子 飾）領軍，集結一群身懷絕技的怪才，專門制裁最棘手難纏的惡德逃稅者，成為體系內獨特而強悍的制裁之刃.

programme.title: Billion x School
programme.desc: 日本最大的財閥集團「加賀美集團」的CEO，也是一位天才發明家，加賀美零隱藏自己的身份，潛入私立絵都學園，成為了一名高中教師。該校的3年0班是一個集合了被認為「無幹勁、無才能、無前途」的學生，被學校其他部分貶低為「零組」。加賀美零將在這樣的環境中，與這些學生共同成長，挑戰教育常規.

programme.desc: 日本國稅局「米」課，是令逃稅者聞風喪膽的最終防線。在其內部，新設了一個原創部門——複雜國稅案件處理室「雜國室」。由米田正子（松嶋菜菜子 飾）領軍，集結一群身懷絕技的怪才，專門制裁最棘手難纏的惡德逃稅者，成為體系內獨特而強悍的制裁之刃.

programme.title: Billion x School
programme.desc: 日本最大的財閥集團「加賀美集團」的CEO，也是一位天才發明家，加賀美零隱藏自己的身份，潛入私立絵都學園，成為了一名高中教師。該校的3年0班是一個集合了被認為「無幹勁、無才能、無前途」的學生，被學校其他部分貶低為「零組」。加賀美零將在這樣的環境中，與這些學生共同成長，挑戰教育常規.

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 故事描述已經脫離工作職場長達7年，以實習生回歸的40多歲女性重投社會工作，在這個像叢林般危險的職場中堅持著、硬撐著生存下去的故事.

programme.title: 許我耀眼
programme.desc: 當紅主播許妍（趙露思飾）和都會精英沈皓明（陳偉霆飾）是一對人人艷羨慕的夫妻，看似十分般配的兩人，由於出生環境的差異，始終難以融入對方的圈子。許妍靠著光鮮的主持人身分和「精心裝點」的身世順利和沈皓明步入婚姻，而這一切盡在沈皓明的掌握下。衝突來臨，許妍脫離沈皓明的掌控一去不回頭。沈皓明卻發現自己早已陷入愛情，想要全力追回許妍。經歷種種，兩人終於撕掉外表的偽裝，重新靠近，會見彼此的內在，也重新認識自己.

programme.title: 月亮在江邊流淌
programme.desc: 講述失去笑容的朝鮮王世子，擁有冷峻氣質與壓倒性的氣場，背負着喪失摯愛與朝廷鬥爭的傷痛。以及樂觀開朗的女攤販，雖然失去部分過去記憶，仍堅強面對生活。在某日二人意外靈魂互換，進而展開對自身與他人命運的重新審視，並因靈魂互換而展開浪漫奇幻愛情故事.

programme.title: Numbers：大廈之林的監視者們
programme.desc: 高中畢業出身會計師張浩宇面對大型會計師事務所的不正之風，以最不像會計師的方式實現正義.

programme.title: 仙女榴槤
programme.desc: 二百年後兩個神祕的女人，突然出現在超級富有的丹氏家族，沒人知道她們是誰。但隨後這兩位女子意識到，在前世她們與丹氏家族的每位成員，都有着密不可分的關係.

programme.desc: 講述失去笑容的朝鮮王世子，擁有冷峻氣質與壓倒性的氣場，背負着喪失摯愛與朝廷鬥爭的傷痛。以及樂觀開朗的女攤販，雖然失去部分過去記憶，仍堅強面對生活。在某日二人意外靈魂互換，進而展開對自身與他人命運的重新審視，並因靈魂互換而展開浪漫奇幻愛情故事.

programme.title: Numbers：大廈之林的監視者們
programme.desc: 高中畢業出身會計師張浩宇面對大型會計師事務所的不正之風，以最不像會計師的方式實現正義.

programme.title: 仙女榴槤
programme.desc: 二百年後兩個神祕的女人，突然出現在超級富有的丹氏家族，沒人知道她們是誰。但隨後這兩位女子意識到，在前世她們與丹氏家族的每位成員，都有着密不可分的關係.

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 故事描述已經脫離工作職場長達7年，以實習生回歸的40多歲女性重投社會工作，在這個像叢林般危險的職場中堅持著、硬撐著生存下去的故事.

programme.title: 月升滄海
programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 平凡之路
programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 熾道
programme.desc: 在福建小島漁村長大的段宇成夢想成為一名跳高運動員，在助教羅娜的循序善誘之下，不僅訓練成績突飛猛進，兩人也在朝夕相處過程中情愫悄悄滋生，最終段宇成突破了極限也同時收穫了和羅娜的真摯愛情.

programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 平凡之路
programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.title: 熾道
programme.desc: 在福建小島漁村長大的段宇成夢想成為一名跳高運動員，在助教羅娜的循序善誘之下，不僅訓練成績突飛猛進，兩人也在朝夕相處過程中情愫悄悄滋生，最終段宇成突破了極限也同時收穫了和羅娜的真摯愛情.

programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 平凡之路
programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 風與潮
programme.desc: 本劇講述二戰期間1942-1945年澳門「孤島」時期的抗戰風雲故事。 1941年12月香港淪陷後，澳葡政府名為“中立”，實則任由日軍澤榮作特務機關橫行霸道。愛國華人何賢、馬萬祺以及中共地下黨柯麟等人以強烈的愛國心與責任感團結同胞，凝聚澳門華人社團力量奮力反抗.

programme.title: 平凡之路
programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.title: 顯微鏡下的大明之絲絹案
programme.desc: 痴迷於數學的帥家默偶然發現金華縣一個歷史遺留問題，他在試圖糾正錯誤的過程中頻頻遇阻，並引發了各利益集團間的博弈。 軍戶出身的帥家默對數學極其感興趣，在一次拿各縣賦稅練習數學時，偶然發現有一筆科目叫作“人丁絲絹”稅收數目有疑點。經過查詢，帥家默知道有人偷換概念、移花接木，把原本各縣的賦稅轉嫁給了一個縣。帥家默瞭解此事後決定申訴，但在申訴過程中遇到重重困難，險些喪命，“人丁絲絹案”就此擱淺。後遇改革，舊案重提，經過帥家默和各方努力才讓真相大白於天下.

programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.title: 顯微鏡下的大明之絲絹案
programme.desc: 痴迷於數學的帥家默偶然發現金華縣一個歷史遺留問題，他在試圖糾正錯誤的過程中頻頻遇阻，並引發了各利益集團間的博弈。 軍戶出身的帥家默對數學極其感興趣，在一次拿各縣賦稅練習數學時，偶然發現有一筆科目叫作“人丁絲絹”稅收數目有疑點。經過查詢，帥家默知道有人偷換概念、移花接木，把原本各縣的賦稅轉嫁給了一個縣。帥家默瞭解此事後決定申訴，但在申訴過程中遇到重重困難，險些喪命，“人丁絲絹案”就此擱淺。後遇改革，舊案重提，經過帥家默和各方努力才讓真相大白於天下.

programme.title: 風與潮
programme.desc: 本劇講述二戰期間1942-1945年澳門「孤島」時期的抗戰風雲故事。 1941年12月香港淪陷後，澳葡政府名為“中立”，實則任由日軍澤榮作特務機關橫行霸道。愛國華人何賢、馬萬祺以及中共地下黨柯麟等人以強烈的愛國心與責任感團結同胞，凝聚澳門華人社團力量奮力反抗.

programme.title: 膽小鬼
programme.desc: 《膽小鬼》電視劇是由檸萌影業、優酷聯合出品，鄭執編劇，張曉波執導，歐豪、王硯輝領銜主演，王玉雯、周依然、侯雯元主演的青春懸疑犯罪短劇集。該劇改編自鄭執的長篇小說《生吞》，該劇講述了一段四個少年的青春往事，多年後一樁重現的罪案，讓所有人不得不面對人性最真實的「黑白戰爭」.

programme.title: 熾道
programme.desc: 在福建小島漁村長大的段宇成夢想成為一名跳高運動員，在助教羅娜的循序善誘之下，不僅訓練成績突飛猛進，兩人也在朝夕相處過程中情愫悄悄滋生，最終段宇成突破了極限也同時收穫了和羅娜的真摯愛情.

programme.title: 月升滄海
programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 平凡之路
programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾

programme.desc: 打破傳統求職單向選擇的邏輯，從企業「滅燈挑錯」的評判模式，升級為發掘求職者自身閃光點的賦能模式。企業面試官可以隨時爆燈拋出橄欖枝，同步明確崗位與薪酬待遇，大幅拓寬求職者的選擇空間，讓雙向匹配更高效、更真誠.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第三季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 海昏行 第2季
programme.desc: 延續上一季，現代人王衡與西漢海昏侯劉賀再度聯手，他們的足跡從長安延伸至豫章，並深入民間；探討他們如何運用現代思維應對宮廷權謀與民間疾苦，在面對地方積弊和幕後黑手的過程中相互砥礪，並努力改寫歷史.

programme.title: 我, 兼職女王
programme.desc: 圍繞「兼職女王」辛桐與四海集團繼承人聞裴安展開，辛桐為替閨蜜搞砸相親而錯誤結識聞裴安，聞裴安因家族逼婚僱傭辛桐假扮契約情侶，二人由此開啟與戀愛監察特工斗智斗勇的爆笑同居之旅.

programme.title: 追星星的人 第3季
programme.sub-title: 共賞南北半球星光點點
programme.desc: 繼續重磅集結，除了經驗豐富的 “全勤者” 吳奇隆外，新成員林峯、丁禹兮、林允、趙小棠也加入「追星團」；在「星空日記」的魔法下，將打游戲的宅男、疲憊的職場打工人和沉浸於網上沖浪的情侶帶出原有空間一路滑行到戶外，讓受困於都市生活的他們探尋星空與美好的秘密.

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫

programme.title: 嗨！唱起來

programme.desc: 蔡少芬、陶昕然、斕曦、張曉龍、藍盈瑩、陳思斯、楊九郎時隔13年後首次合體重聚，以全新的面貌組成「煥新團」，從承載無數記憶的《甄嬛傳》拍攝地北京大觀園出發，自北向南，由東向西，前往全國多個寶藏民族文化發源地，通過深度探訪、遊學，體驗各地民俗文化和風土人情，帶著回憶和新的憧憬環遊全國以完成“煥新之旅”.

programme.title: 萌探探探案 第三季

programme.title: 亞洲新聲
programme.sub-title: 黃玲李玖哲迎戰00後唱將
programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演.

programme.title: 海昏行 第2季
programme.desc: 延續上一季，現代人王衡與西漢海昏侯劉賀再度聯手，他們的足跡從長安延伸至豫章，並深入民間；探討他們如何運用現代思維應對宮廷權謀與民間疾苦，在面對地方積弊和幕後黑手的過程中相互砥礪，並努力改寫歷史.

programme.title: 我愛古詩詞 第三季 第3季
programme.desc: 運用了經常出現在電影中的特效技術來拍攝，讓觀眾從不同的角度觀看，像置身於拍攝現場一樣；除了有課本上的詩詞內容外，還融入國風體育運動、美術繪畫、音樂表演等內容，利用豐富有趣的環節形式激發青少年學習傳統文化的熱情.

programme.desc: 全新互動音樂節目，以「星素結合」的形式全民共唱。100位素人歌手將通過現場K歌贏得機會成為三位幸運歌手，與每集的大咖歌手進行合唱挑戰，實現自己的夢想。大咖歌手嘉賓包括孫楠、羽泉等.

programme.title: 約見名醫
programme.desc: 全新研發的大型互動健康科普節目；從「重治療」到「重預防」，加大醫療健康知識的深度普及，把權威的資訊送到身邊.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.desc: 突破傳統的交友方式，24位單身女生以亮燈和滅燈方式來決定男嘉賓去留，通過「愛之初體驗」、「愛之再判斷」、「愛之終決選」、「男生權利」等決定男女嘉賓的速配成功.

programme.title: 我們相愛吧 第3季
programme.desc: 三對明星情侶：內地演員鄭愷與圈外女友程曉玥，台灣歌手潘瑋柏搭檔內地女主持吳昕，台灣演員明道搭檔內地女演員王鷗；還有素人情侶加入，一起修煉愛情，傳遞正能量.

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第4季
programme.desc: 30+的素人嘉賓們帶著成熟與期待，在摩登都市上海入住郊區小屋，從陌生到熟悉，從心動到堅定，共同開啟一段30天的尋愛之旅；除了元老嘉賓謝楠、張純燁、唐藝昕之外，更邀請了徐藝洋和顏安等組成「半熟觀察員」，一同見證高甜瞬間.

programme.title: 海昏行 第2季
programme.desc: 延續上一季，現代人王衡與西漢海昏侯劉賀再度聯手，他們的足跡從長安延伸至豫章，並深入民間；探討他們如何運用現代思維應對宮廷權謀與民間疾苦，在面對地方積弊和幕後黑手的過程中相互砥礪，並努力改寫歷史.

programme.title: 我, 兼職女王
programme.desc: 圍繞「兼職女王」辛桐與四海集團繼承人聞裴安展開，辛桐為替閨蜜搞砸相親而錯誤結識聞裴安，聞裴安因家族逼婚僱傭辛桐假扮契約情侶，二人由此開啟與戀愛監察特工斗智斗勇的爆笑同居之旅.

programme.title: 老板不知道的我：老友季
programme.desc: 節目全新升級，以「老友季」作為主題，把觀察樣本聚焦在情感更濃、羈絆更深的職場戰友身上，對職場上下級關系的維度進行了深度開拓；通過職場老友這一切面，去探討職場中更復雜的問題解法.

programme.title: 2021江蘇衛視跨年演唱會
programme.desc: 頂級夢幻舞美，豪華明星陣容，陪你一起倒數迎接新年到來! 嘉賓包括：李克勤、朴樹、韓紅、李宇春、周筆暢、譚維維、毛不易、張傑、周深、王源、劉維、郎朗、金晨、王霏霏、薛之謙、硬糖少女303、THE9組合等.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第三季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 海昏行 第2季
programme.desc: 延續上一季，現代人王衡與西漢海昏侯劉賀再度聯手，他們的足跡從長安延伸至豫章，並深入民間；探討他們如何運用現代思維應對宮廷權謀與民間疾苦，在面對地方積弊和幕後黑手的過程中相互砥礪，並努力改寫歷史.

programme.title: 我, 兼職女王
programme.desc: 圍繞「兼職女王」辛桐與四海集團繼承人聞裴安展開，辛桐為替閨蜜搞砸相親而錯誤結識聞裴安，聞裴安因家族逼婚僱傭辛桐假扮契約情侶，二人由此開啟與戀愛監察特工斗智斗勇的爆笑同居之旅.

programme.title: 可愛的旅行
programme.desc: 以寵物為主角，萌寵們在「鏟屎官」的帶領下，前往上海、大理、深圳三座城市，從城市到田園，從森林到海邊，讓觀眾看到人寵相伴的多樣出行方式，了解到流浪動物的救助計劃，以及探索人與寵物的和諧相處的新方法.

programme.title: 萬卷風雅集
programme.desc: 中的名場面，用現代方式表達其中蘊藏的經典文化與精神內涵，彰顯中華文明突出特性。邀請陳銘、喻恩泰、楊迪、王子異組成「萬卷遊學團」，羅一舟、張凌赫、張曉龍、王耀慶、王鶴棣、曾可妮作為「風雅體驗官」，分別體驗五場穿越千年的古今同游，根據遊學攻略不斷加載知識技能，最終完成「傳世名作名場面」的融創秀.

programme.title: 極限挑戰 第十季
programme.sub-title: 極挑兄弟cos西遊記尋找「真假分身
programme.desc: 「極挑團」原班人馬將與新成員一起解鎖更多挑戰，他們將與廣大觀眾一起跨越大江南北，體驗國民生活百態，用真心探訪這片古老土地上正在發生的溫情故事，以更豐富的視角觸摸這卷山河下每一位個體的對美好生活的深切期望.

programme.title: 大逃亡
programme.desc: Steve McQueen jumps on his motorcycle and leads the way in this thrill-packed adventure that blends top stars, a true-life WWII saga and Hollywood's gift for storytelling into a bravura, blockbuster film.

programme.title: 律政俏佳人
programme.desc: When Elle, a sorority queen, is dumped by her boyfriend as he plans to go to law school, she enrols in the same school to win him back. However, she discovers that there is more to her than her looks.

programme.title: 出軌
programme.desc: A middle-aged wife and mother has an affair with a handsome younger man, but her husband murders him when he finds out about the affair, and husband and wife must reckon with what happened.

programme.title: 鐵三角
programme.desc: Life has not been kind to Sam, Fai and Mok as they struggle to make ends meet. Routine visits to bars seem to be their only way out of miseries. Until a stormy evening when a mysterious old man appears before them with a tip: An ancient treasure is buried under the high-security Legislative Building. All they have to do is sneak in and retrieve it; if they believe in his story. Sam, Fai and Mok agree to make a run for the treasure to test their fate. What they uncover is beyond anything they expected: An ancient coffin containing a ceremonial robe made of gold..

credits.director: 徐克, 林嶺東, 杜琪峯

programme.title: 怒潮
programme.desc: Amid the transfer of power at the Hongtai Group, which wields influence in both the lawful and unlawful worlds, a mysterious assassin named Chen An suddenly enters this vortex of confusion and throws the Hongtai Group into chaos. Mai Longwen from the police and Ma Wenkang from the gangs both have their eyes on him... Various forces are waiting for the opportunity to strike. Who is the mastermind behind the scenes? A fierce battle is about to break out.

programme.title: 我的婆婆黃飛鴻
programme.desc: Gucci, an ordinary teenage girl grows up in a single-parent family. In order to protect her good friend, she fights with somebody and is sent to girls' home. After release, she knows her mother died in a car accident. So she doesn't have a choice but to live with her weird grandmother, Wong Fei Hung. Gucci does not like Wong's old-fashion and strange character and they always quarrel about some unimportant issues. Gucci has fallen in love with a bartender. However, happy times always can't last, bad luck seems still follow Gucci.....

programme.title: 戀愛大都會
programme.desc: Searching for true love in this prejudiced world. Jae-hee is a free-spirited girl who often becomes the center of rumors, while her classmate Heung-soo struggles to hide his true identity. One night at the bar district, Jae-hee discovers the other side of Heung-soo that no one else knows and helps him keep it a secret in public. As Heung-soo accidentally becomes Jae-hee's roommate, they realize that despite not being each other's ideal types, their companionship fosters a deep and strong friendship. Together, they navigate life's unexpected challenges and rely on each other like family as they courageously pursue their own paths in love and life.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -熾熱的配音初體驗
programme.desc: New title of the Crayon Shinchan movie series, “Crayon Shinchan the Movie: Super-Hot! The Spicy Kasukabe Dancers”, has been released. For Hong Kong's Cantonese-dubbed version, singer Cloud Wan Ho Ying and new generation idol Phoebus Ng Kai Yeung have been invited to voice over two new characters. In this episode, Cloud and Phoebus will share the anecdotes from their dubbing experience; Phoebus will demonstrate some voice over techniques, and more behind-the-scene stories are to be told.

programme.title: 蠟筆小新劇場版：我的搬家物語 仙人掌大襲擊
programme.desc: Hiroshi was ordered to collect the fruit of cactus and was transferred to Mexico. So, Nohara family had to move to Mexico and live there. They had to bid farewell to their acquaintances and the citizens of Kasukabe with tears. Shinnosuke heard that Mexican young girls are stylish and beautiful and became eager for this journey. On arriving at Madakueruyobaka city in Mexico, a new life full of anxiety, surrounded by unique neighbors awaits them. But Shinnosuke and Nohara family had no idea that flesh-eating killer cacti are going to attack.

programme.title: 非常幸運
programme.desc: Going nowhere in love and stuck in life as a lowly travel agent, Sophie finds escape in her own comic book creations. When she was winning the office contest for a prize trip to Singapore suddenly turns her life upside in the best way possible, as she meets there the man of her dreams: David, the handsome super-spy from her own comics. Before she can even get pack her luggage together, off they jump from the Marina Bay Sands Skydeck, and the chase is on for a lip-shaped key to the billion-dollar diamond called “Lucky Star Diamond”, a diamond capable of destroying the world, one country at a time.

programme.title: 這個阿爸真爆炸
programme.desc: Ying is a single parent who's having a tough time disciplining his wild teenage daughter Ellen. When Ying is mistaken to be the famous gangster hero 'Shadowless Eagle', he gains both recognition and popularity among Ellen's gangster classmates, and she begins to gain new respect for her father. But Ying's legend becomes more than he can handle when some real triad members come seeking revenge.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 戀愛病毒
programme.desc: The world is under attack from an “Love virus”? Taek-seon is a translator who always feels tired, unmotivated and uninterested in romance. One day, Taek-seon has a disastrous blind date with Su-pil, a born single medical researcher who proposes on their first meeting. After the date they met, the world is suddenly enveloped in atmosphere of love... Taek-seon found herself laughing for no reason and searching for a beautiful dress, everything looks cute, even a daily promotional text from her old classmate Yeon-woo. However, Taek-seon knew that she had been infected with 100% fatality rate deadly virus -- Toxo Virus. She meets Dr. Lee Gyun, the only researcher who can create the antiviral medicine and she realizes that all these romantic feelings are symptoms of virus. Thus, her unexpected journey begins..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -寒戰前哨站
programme.desc: The long-awaited “Cold War” series returns! Director Longman Leung together with Terrance Lau and Louise Wong disclose the untold stories of filming “Cold War 1994”. While Terrance reveals filming car chase scenes had been his brush with death, Louise confesses to being stressed to play the role of a gang boss for the first time that took her three months of preparation for the action scenes. Longman also shares about the tycoon kidnapping case in the film inspired by real cases from the 1990s.....

programme.title: 人間蒸發
programme.desc: Jia Jia went to Japan with her fiance to meet her family. As soon as she arrived at the foot of Mount Fuji, she was imprisoned by local villagers and led an inhuman life. The cowardly Hirota only knew how to sorrow through wine. Jia Jia's good sister Wei Ling resolutely went to Japan to find Jia Jia. With the help of agent Kinoshita, the investigation gradually deepened, but the surrounding environment became more and more sinister. Hirota was strangled to death in a hot spring pool. Michiko went mad because of extreme fear. Yuko was still sane but unable to express when she was attacked. Tadao often spied Wei Ling through the cracks in the door. Residents under the shadow of nuclear radiation gradually lost their humanity, like a hyena, and ready to bite Wei Ling this outsider.

programme.title: 黑社會
programme.desc: The time has come, as it does every two years, for the senior members of Hong Kong's oldest Triad, The Wo Shing Society, to elect a new chairman. Fierce rivalries emerge between the two eligible candidates. Lok, respected by the Uncles is the favorite to win. But his rival Big D will stop at nothing to change this, including going against hundreds of years of Triad tradition and influencing the vote with money and violence.

programme.title: 黑社會2以和為貴
programme.desc: In post-1997 Hong Kong, even the long-established “Wo Shing” Triad Society has to succumb to the power of China. The entrepreneurial sect leader Jimmy (Louis Koo) seems to be the perfect candidate to lead the Society into the new Millennium. Only problem is, Jimmy wants out..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 體驗撈金魚吧
programme.desc: Makoto Kashiba is angry and depressed after losing his job as an elite banker and being sent to the countryside. By chance (Or is it fate?) he meets a beautiful girl, Kitsuno. However, the man she's in love with is master pianist and goldfish catcher, Noboru Oji. Bonds between them form, and a love triangle begins..

programme.title: 末日廝殺橋
programme.desc: Due to sudden deteriorating weather conditions, visibility on the Airport Bridge is severely impaired, leaving people stranded and at risk of the bridge collapsing due to a series of chain collisions and explosions. Amidst the chaos, the canine subjects 'Echo' from the military experiment 'Project Silence,' who were being transported in secret, break free, and all human survivors become targets of relentless attacks. Various individuals find themselves stranded on the Airport Bridge for different reasons - a government official from the presidential office who was seeing off his daughter at the airport; a tow truck driver who was on his way to a multi-collision scene; an elderly who were returning from a trip abroad; sisters who missed their flights, and Dr. Yang, the researcher responsible for Project Silence - and a desperate struggle begins for them to escape to safety.

programme.title: 燃冬
programme.desc: In cold wintry Yanji in northern China, visiting urbanite Haofeng feels lost and adrift. By chance, he meets Nana, a tour guide who instantly fascinates him. She introduces him to Xiao, a personable but frustrated restaurant worker. The trio bond quickly over a drunken weekend, fueled by a bit of lust. Confronting their individual traumas, their frozen desires slowly thaw as they seek to liberate themselves from an icy world.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 回憶三部曲
programme.desc: From the creative supervision of Katsuhiro OTOMO ('STEAMBOY', 'SHORT PEACE'), comes 'MEMORIES', a three-part work based on OTOMO's three original stories. ('MAGNETIC ROSE') Set in outer space at the end of the 21st century, the 1st part tells the story of two engineers who encounter the apparition of a female opera singer in an abandoned space freighter... ('STINK BOMB') The 2nd story is a satirical tale of a young lab technician who accidentally swallows experimental pills... ('CANNON FODDER') The 3rd part depicts war-time life in an imaginary world, using a characteristic camerawork.

credits.director: 大友克洋, 森本晃司, 岡村天齋

programme.title: 心裏美
programme.desc: Mr. K.K. Ho, is a leading “star tutor” with remarkable achievements. Lee Lung Kei , the stingy boss and principal of the cram school, regards Mr. Ho as a trump card. Chloe, a traditional high school teacher, has always tried her best in teaching. Chloe despises K.K.'s teaching methods and refers to them as deviant. The two of them give tit for tat in class. Their conflict leads to K.K.'s appreciation for Chloe. He gives her flowers as an apology, but Chloe never accepts. He finds out Chloe is the daughter of Principal Lee. When she was young, she witnessed her mother being bullied and died by accident. That is why she deeply hates her father and refuses to get in touch with him. K.K. with wisdom and courage, who breaks through all the obstacles to pursue Chloe but also takes into account the father-daughter relationship. However, he learns Chloe has genetic heart disease and what's worse, due to her diligent teaching for years, the doctor believes that she could only live for.

programme.title: 逆權司機
programme.desc: May 1980. A Seoul taxi driver named Man-seob comes across an offer too good to be true. If he drives a foreign passenger from Seoul down to Gwangju and back again before the curfew, he'll be paid the unthinkable sum of 100,000 won – enough to cover several months of unpaid rent. Without stopping to ask the details, he picks up the German reporter Peter and sets off along the highway. Although stopped by police roadblocks at the edge of Gwangju, Man-seob is desperate to earn his taxi fare, and eventually manages to find a way into the city. There they encounter students and ordinary citizens taking part in large-scale demonstrations against the government. Man-seob, alarmed by the danger in the air, pleads with Peter to go quickly back to Seoul. But Peter ignores him..

programme.title: 奪命金
programme.desc: “Life Without Principle” tells the story of three ordinary citizens, bank teller Teresa, triad thug Panther and Police inspector Cheung Jin Fong, whose lives are turned upside down by a bizarre robbery. Hammered by the predicaments of their respective lives, what are their choices between money and principles.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 炸豬排DJ揚太郎
programme.desc: Agetaro is the heir to his family's long-running tonkatsu (fried pork cutlet) restaurant in Shibuya, Tokyo. He spends his days chopping cabbages and slacking off because he has nothing else better to do. One day, he goes to a dance club to deliver a bento, and is thrilled to get a chance to speak to Sonoko, the girl he secretly has a crush on. He also experiences the excitement of the dance floor grooving to the music for the first time, and is filled with an uplifting sensation that he has never felt before. To win Sonoko's heart, Agetaro decides to become the “Tonkatsu DJ”, a guy who can cook both tonkatsu and the dance floor.

programme.title: 遺愛
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, young mother Elisa was found guilty of manslaughter; twenty years later, her orphaned girl, Daisy, was arrested for drug possession. Tragedy remains trapped in a fateful loop cursing generations to generations of youth..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場

programme.title: JSA安全地帶
programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight..

At first, it seemed like a luxury to be able to work outside the shackles of the office, but people quickly realized that it could also drive them insane. For Coba, work-from-home has led to a daily cage match with his family. When he inadvertently learns that his mother's homemade chili sauce is a hit with his co-workers, he convinces his family to turn the chili sauce into an online business in order to divert their attention away from conflicts. However, Coba didn't expect that the sauce would become a timely internet sensation, thanks to families eating at home more often during the pandemic.

programme.title: 火龍

As their paths intertwine, she realizes that everyone carries their own shadows, and the deeper she digs, the closer she gets to a chilling revelation. In Butterfly Mansion, the greatest lesson she learns is this: Humans Are More Terrifying Than Ghosts.

programme.desc: After a high-ranking North Korean official requests asylum, KCIA Foreign Unit chief Park Pyong-ho (LEE Jung Jae) and Domestic Unit chief Kim Jung-do (JUNG Woo Sung) are tasked with uncovering a North Korean spy, known as Donglim, who is deeply embedded within their agency. When the spy begins leaking top secret intel that could jeopardize national security, the two units are each assigned to investigate each other. In this tense situation where if they cannot find the mole, they may be accused themselves, Pyong-ho and Jung-do slowly start to uncover the truth. In the end, they must deal with an unthinkable plot to assassinate the South Korean president..

programme.title: 投名狀
programme.desc: In the fall of 1870, General Pang stands high atop the city walls fully attired in governor's robes. Peering down upon the site of his inauguration, he is filled with dreams and ambition. Pang has taken a path of no return; had he chosen differently, he might have been one of the heroes to later overthrow the corrupt Qing imperial regime and establish a new China. He could have changed the course of history. But two bandits and a woman have changed the course of his life, helping him achieve his goal, but ultimately causing his demise. The two bandits are his sworn blood brothers: Zhao Er-Hu and Jiang Wu-Yang..

programme.title: 只因我們天生一對：電影版
programme.desc: Tine Mr. Chic, a cheeky good-looking university student, finds himself in big trouble after being romantically and aggressively chased by Green, a handsome guy. To push Green away, Tine asks Sarawat, the hottest guy on campus, to pretend to flirt with him. Little does he know that there is not even a shred of pretense in Sarawat's flirt. Not to Tine's knowledge, a few years ago, Sarawat met Tine at a Scrubb concert and fell for Tine ever since. That is how a fake flirt operation becomes true love for Sarawat and Tine whose story is told through hit songs by Scrubb.

programme.title: 搶紅
programme.desc: Shui Zhang and Waley were buddies at an orphanage. Adopted by a French couple and moved to France at a young age, Waley has become a wine connoisseur prodigy. Left alone in China, Shui Zhang grows up to be a braggart and a nobody. When Shui Zhang travels to France one day to enlist Waley's help in auctioning a bottle of red wine called 'The God of Wine,' said to contain Kublai Khan's secret wine-brewing recipe, Waley accepted the challenge in a heartbeat. During the auction, Waley encounters a representative from the seller, the beautiful Yvonne, and falls in love with her at first sight. The other potential buyer is the wealthy and imposing coal tycoon Changfang Fang. While he appears to be a rich and vulgar brute on the surface, he is much more than meets the eyes. Adding to the mystery is the private connoisseur of suspicious origins following Fang everywhere. To Waley's surprise, Zhang and Fang seem to be sharing secrets between themselves. The group of buyers set off an.

programme.title: 公寓裡的兩個女人
programme.desc: Yi-jung lives with her mother Su-kyung, but they do not get along well with each other. While out grocery shopping one day, they fight as usual and Su-kyung's car ends up hitting Yi-jung in the parking lot. Yi-jung does not believe Su-kyung's claim that the car suddenly accelerated on its own and thinks her mother hit her on purpose. Now, Yi-jung wants an apology from Su-kyung for everything that happened in her life.

programme.title: 無間道 II
programme.desc: Forty-five years later, the man's sins come back to haunt his son, a professor specializing in sleeping disorders, when the lady's ghost returns for vengeance.

programme.title: 重生
programme.desc: In a secluded corner of Mancheng City, a ruthless drug trafficking group stops at nothing to achieve their goals, leading to countless individuals falling into the abyss of shattered families due to drug addiction. Zhang Yao, who has been persecuted by drug traffickers to the point of losing everything, seeks revenge. He secretly collaborates with Captain An Du of the anti-drug squad to set up a ruthless trap to eliminate the top bosses of the criminal syndicate. However, behind this plan lies a carefully orchestrated game of revenge. Do they have the same enemy or do they each have their own hidden agendas? In this showdown, who is truly in control, and who is merely a pawn being manipulated? As the crisis looms, will they sink or awaken to reality? Proceed with caution as everything unfolds..

programme.title: 淪落人
programme.desc: A paralyzed and hopeless man meets his new Filipino domestic helper who has put her dreams on hold to come to Hong Kong to earn a living. These two strangers live under the same roof, and they learn to face the different seasons of life.

programme.title: 談判專家
programme.desc: Negotiator expert Cheuk Man Wai unexpectedly becomes the prime suspect in a murder case. Forced into a corner, he occupies the police station, taking officers hostage, and demands negotiations with the former negotiator Tse Ka Chun. With Tse's expertise in psychological manipulation and Cheuk's exceptional skills, they engage in a battle of wits. As the verbal sparring deepens, their positions and mindsets gradually change...This film is adapted from the American movie 'The Negotiator'.

programme.title: 最後的怒放
programme.desc: Forty years after leaving Japan for a boxing career in the U.S. that never panned out, Jin returns to restart his life with his old boxing buddies. When hotheaded young boxer Shogo asks for Jin's help to get him back into the ring after an unfair loss, the two men decide to seize their final chance at glory.

programme.title: 小白龍情海翻波
programme.desc: 'Little White Dragon', a noblewoman and a kung fu hero whose beauty soon caught the eyes of the crown prince. He sent White Dragon to capture an assassin, a blind swordsman..

programme.title: 絕境找微光: 女人街，再見了
programme.desc: A 11-year-old illegal immigrant, Tung, stays and lives in the Ladies' Market with T-shirt seller, Fai. One day, Tung rescued Yan who is kidnapped. Two of them bumped into van driver Pui Yi and gangster Ho..

programme.title: 特工爺爺
programme.desc: Bodyguard, The follows a retired bodyguard (Hung) who has settled in the dark and unknown corner of the world where China, Russia and North Korea meet. Suffering from the beginnings of dementia, Bodyguard, The is befriended by a young girl whose life is threatened when her father (Lau) falls in with the local crime world. When the girl and her father disappear, Bodyguard, The must call upon his long forgotten skills to save the life of his young friend.

programme.title: 怪物
programme.desc: When her young son Minato starts to behave strangely, his mother feels that there is something wrong. Discovering that a teacher is responsible, she storms into the school demanding to know what's going on. But as the story unfolds through the eyes of mother, teacher and child, the truth gradually emerges.

programme.title: 凶靈祭
programme.desc: A horrifying story of a shaman's inheritance in the Isan region of Thailand. What could be possessing a family member might not be the Goddess they make it out to be. A documentary team follows Nim, a shaman based in Northern Thai, the Isan area, and encounters her niece Mink showing strange symptoms that seem to be of inheritance of shamanism. The team decides to follow Mink, hoping to capture the shaman lineage passing on to the next generation, but her bizarre behavior becomes more extreme.

programme.title: 第一誡
programme.desc: Every day, the Police Force receives 185 phone calls.180 of them are about burglaries, murders, rapes and kidnappings. The remaining 5 begin with: “There is something strange in my house, can you please send someone over to take a look?” For rookie Sergeant Lee, being a cop means running down crooks and upholding the law. Injured in a shoot-out, he finds out to his horror that he is reassigned to the dubious-sounding Miscellaneous Affairs Department (MAD)..

programme.title: 隔牆有愛
programme.desc: Flirting with a wall between them! Seung-jin wants to become a singer, so he's preparing for a TV audition program. It's his first night at his new place. He suddenly hears a woman's ghostly wails! It turns out that Seung-jin's next door neighbor, Ra-ni has been driving people away from this apartment because of the super-thin walls! But Seung-jin won't go without a fight! After a battle of loud noises, they decide to take turns being noisy. They don't know each other's names or faces. But as they share their lives, they start to develop strange feelings for each other... The thin walls force them to share everything with each other. It's a brand new kind of romance.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 惠子的凝視
programme.desc: Despite battling lifelong deafness, Keiko has managed to turn pro and obtain a winning record. But as her mentor faces health issues and her gym faces imminent closure due to the pandemic, Keiko finds her will to keep fighting starting to wane.

programme.title: 掃毒3: 人在天涯
programme.desc: Hong Kong police agent Cheung works undercover in Kang's drug cartel, while another undercover cop Au successfully earns their trust in an incident, a brotherly-bond is built among the three. After the Police busts the syndicate in Hong Kong, Kang subsequently hide away in the Golden Triangle, by chance he receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust..

programme.title: 愛情萬歲
programme.desc: Ching and Sung work in “Love Cafe” in the dazzling Soho and the main job is to cure broken hearts. But happiness won't last forever. After gathering with schoolmates, where Ching's ex-boyfriend Hung showed up, depute between Ching and Sung breaks out and their plan to study in Beijing almost vanishes... Joe met Kelly in a disco and falls into her in the first sight. However, Kelly is in fact a weapon of Joe's ex-girlfriend for revenge. But the more Kelly knows about Joe, the less she can pull herself out of the relationship... Yu has a handsome and career type boyfriend who will buy her everything. But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. But their 6-year age difference seems a gap that Yu couldn't step forward.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 韓戲逼人
programme.desc: After his successful debut, Director KIM endures scathing attacks from critics who call him a specialist in trashy dramas. After finishing his latest feature ‘Cobweb', he has vivid dreams over several days of an alternative ending to the film. Sensing that if he can just shoot those scenes as he envisioned them, a masterpiece will surely emerge, he tries to arrange just two days of additional shooting. However, the rewritten script fails to pass censorship, and his actors can't make sense of the new ending. Between the tangled schedule, the opposition of the producer, and the collision between these fantastic scenes dancing before his eyes and the harsh conditions of reality, Director KIM feels he is about to go insane, but he pushes on regardless..

programme.title: 蠟筆小新劇場版：超時空！我的新娘
programme.desc: Shinchan Nohara sends a girl named Tamiko on a mission to bring his five-year-old self to that time period right before being captured. Reaching the past, she claims to be Shinchan's bride and takes him and his friends on a wild adventure to try to save the world to come.

programme.title: 抱抱俏佳人
programme.desc: One night, wedding planner - Yan met a young attorney, Fun and had a one-night stand. Later, Fung did accidentally join to Yan's wedding planning company. In a special wedding, regardless of Yan against Fung, the rigid procedures of the wedding ceremony turned into a warm, touching the carnival. Customers in more than touched, the two are deeply moved a step closer so emotional. However, the emotional harm suffered psychological Yan still cannot break the shackles of courage in the face of her girlfriends Fung's hand holding a bold recognition of this relationship. At this time, her fiance - Kelvin was again disrupted Yan's emotional world. Who is her true Love....

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -識於微塵
programme.desc: Composer Wong Hin-yan won Hong Kong Film Awards and Golden Horse Awards' ‘Best Original Film Score' with The Narrow Road which was directed by his buddy Lam Sum. In this episode, the two will share about the correlation between soundtracks and visual images, and also look back on their paths from school to films.

programme.title: 絕境找微光: 窄路微塵
programme.desc: Under this flashy city, amidst the numbness of frustrations, what people are looking forward to is the glimmer of light that might change their lives. Chak, who runs a small cleaning company, barely takes over the cleaning work on his own to make a living. Hitting by the COVID-19 pandemic, small business closed down one by one. One day, a young single mother, Candy, comes to look for a job opportunity from Chak. She doesn't seem like a trustworthy person to Chak, unexpectedly, she helps Chak to resolve many difficulties at work. Life seems like get back on track. The morning sun never lasts a day, Chak's company is being accused, at the same time, his family is facing a nightmare as well, all his hopes are dashed to pieces, but they can still try their best to resist the oppression of life and support each other through this painful year.

programme.title: 水餃皇后
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang Jianhe, a woman from Qingdao, was forced to leave her hometown with her two daughters. To make ends meet and raise her children, she washed dishes by day and cleaned cars by night. With no one to rely on, she bore the immense pressure alone. Determined to break free from her fate, Zang Jianhe decided to make a living by selling dumplings. From struggling to attract customers to eventually thriving, she received much support from tough-but-kind Hong Jie, Brother Hua, and Uncle Dessert. Through perseverance, she grew her dumpling business into a success, and her life gradually opened up to new possibilities... The film is based on a true story.

programme.title: 有情飲水飽
programme.desc: Richard Ma is a tightfisted, mean and unpleasant character. He is also a wealthy businessman who has become increasingly bitter and mistrustful due to what he believes are the gold-digging women in his life. Following a series of events one weekend, Richard's financial assets are temporarily frozen, his house is looted by his bitter ex-girlfriend and he has no cash leaving him helpless and broke. It is during this fateful weekend that he meets Choi; a struggling stockbroker who is trying ward off the attentions of an unwanted suitor from her local village. By offering to help to Ah Choi in return for financial gain, a most surprising relationship develops between this unlikely pair.

programme.title: 賭后
programme.desc: Nan, a gambling goddess from Mainland China who is smart and has extraordinary martial arts skills. She comes to Hong Kong alone to find her cousin Bao who lives there. Her target: a crooked investor and card shark extraordinaire. When Nan's underhanded opponent proves too much to handle on her own, she enlists the aid of some rather unusual helpers, including an overconfident casino playboy, a disastrously awkward stuntman, and a perky martial arts princess. Pooling their various talents, Nan concocts a crazy scheme to take down her adversary that is destined to go down in gambling history.

programme.title: 殭屍家族
programme.desc: Antique dealer Kwok roams the countryside with his two assistants searching for rare objects. One day they fall into the cellar of a shrine. There they find three vampires, all rendered harmless by talismans. Kwok takes Sonny Vampire to town, but when the talisman is removed accidentally, the vampire escapes and is being hidden by 6-year-old Chia Chia then. Papa Vampire and Mama Vampire are awakened too when the talismans fall off. Dr. Lin and reporter Ha decide to help stop the vampires from killing people..

programme.title: 歡場
programme.desc: In an unprecedented and sensational move, the police force dismisses seven policewomen simultaneously. They are The Flirt, Diety, Gold-digger, Sherry Holmes, Sixfooter Plus, Plump and Sgt. Crab-pincers. In fact, they are all assigned to a case to catch a sex fiend who has already murdered four night club hostesses. The seven girls work at the biggest night club Crime City Club after training. A promotional gimmick launches: prize for the team of hostesses with the most votes from customers. QE's team jumps to the lead and has a good laugh at the former policewomen. Crab-pincers is angered. Putting aside their assignment, she and her girls go to war to win customers and votes. At the same time, a sex magazine photographer Big John, who happens to be QE's brother, invites The Flirt to a photo session..

programme.title: 驚天十二小時
programme.desc: Tarka Lama, a famous leader of religion in Asia and also a Chinese leader-in-exile, visits Singapore with his disciple/escort for a special mission. No sooner have they arrived the airport, Lama is assassinated in the welcoming ceremony..

programme.title: 靈氣迫人
programme.desc: Angie was an undergraduate from Canada who was in holiday in Hong Kong as well as doing research work for her thesis - 'Chinese Superstition'. She looked for accommodation and met Hansom. While Angie disguised herself as a ghost to scare Hansom, he was thrown out of the window by a genuine ghost. Detective Valentino came to investigate the accident and they unfolded the actual happening of the tragic evening when Singer Lisa Law had shot her lover..

programme.title: 君子好逑
programme.desc: A group of intellectuals, who all actively involved in a psychological research, assume a subject Fai, who is innocent and aimless in his life, to test if love can make him into a different person. Jo Jo is the chosen girl to carry out the mission, who attracts Fai with her elegance and beauty. At the same time, she finds herself attracted by him. She wants Professor Cheung, her boyfriend, to stop such a cruel test, but she fails. The final commitment comes when Jo Jo marries to Cheung. Fai interrupts the wedding ceremony in the church by announcing his love to Jo Jo..

programme.title: 求戀期
programme.desc: The friends of Choi and his girlfriend Mimi always say that the two of them do not look like a couple. So, Choi decides to change his image to be more 'punky'. However, Mimi not only spurns his changes, but also feels there are some problems between them and asks for a break-up. Paul is a 'playboy'. In a rainy night, he meets Yung. She has an unpredictable character. Paul's courtship skills do not work on her. Paul is helpless. Indeed, Yung likes Paul but she is afraid that one day she may really fall in love with Paul so she goes back to Canada. Though unwilling, Paul has to put an end to this relationship.

programme.title: 世上「母」難事: 富貴逼人
programme.desc: News reporter Bill and his wife live in a public housing flat with their 3 daughters. Their dream is to get rich someday. When Lady Luck comes knocking on their door one day and they win the first prize of the local lottery, Mark Six, all hell break loose..

programme.title: 契媽唔易做
programme.desc: A Chinese illegal immigrant “Cousin” wrongly trusted his friend Kwok to rob a jewellery shop. Kwok managed to escape and Cousin is so scared to hide himself in the vehicle which is rented by Ah Ching to remove to the rural area. Ah Ching is suffered by the high pressure from her work and city life. She also has to worry about her boyfriend Fai who is a police inspector. She is determined to pack up and move into remote area to escape from all this. She doesn't know a stranger (Cousin) is right at her back. Ah Ching meets with Pak Lam who is reared in the village by his greedy father Uncle Tat. Ah Ching finds it so ridiculous that naturally she sympathizes the kid. Pak Lam visits Ah Ching's new home to play TV games. He bumped into the scared Cousin who is still hiding there. He and Pak Lam come into an agreement not to reveal his identity to the others. Cousin has no attention to hurt anybody. He even stands out to protect Ah Ching and Pak Lam when the gangs in the village tr.

programme.title: 八仙飯店之人肉叉燒包
programme.desc: In August 1985, a mutilated corpse is found on the beach of Macao. A police investigation uncovers the mysterious disappearance of the entire family of the Eight Immortals Restaurant. Based on a shocking and horrifying true story.

Soon, Yuan's veins start to burst, Wesley sends Yuan, Rainbow and Betsy's boy-friend back to find Buddha's Eye, which can cure Yuan. The wicked priest has directed the blood demon to attack Yuan and his friends. Wesley comes up with the weapons to destroy their wicked enemies..

programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, just breaks up with his model girlfriend Peggy. In order to release Alex's anxiety, his friend invites him to be the part time director of a choir. Alex meets Vivian in the choir. However, Vivian's mother Chu Lai Ngo, a divorced woman who dislikes Alex at the first sight. When Alex and Chu are getting closer and closer, they imperceptibly fall in love with each other. At this moment, Peggy suddenly comes back to Alex asking for being together once again. Alex has to make his choice of love between these two women..

programme.title: 雌雄大盜
programme.desc: An armed couple breaks in the venue of the world-renowned jewelry designer Yamamoto's exhibition in Tokyo and takes away the most valuable pieces on display. The robbery ends in bloodshed. Inspector Fujioka's assistant is shot to death at the crime scene. The couple takes the jewelry to Hong Kong and Fujioka follows their trail. Madam Yang of the Hong Kong Police is assigned to help him. However, Yang's superior and uncle intervenes the investigation. Fujioka is tired of such power struggle and decides to act on his own accord..

programme.title: 妙探雙龍
programme.desc: Kent was a member of the underground gang in the United States. He was attacked by the gangsters upon holding the key evidence of their criminal offences. Kent had no alternative but to seek FBI's protection. He mailed the crime evidence to his sister in Hong Kong. At the same time, he disguised as a girl and fled to Hong Kong. Here he contacted Mr. Green Village, leader of the underground gang for the selling of the smuggled diamond. His identification was revealed by two CID, Ching Shing and Tai Kau. Kent was brought to the Police Station and put under close supervision. They waited for Cindy, the FBI Officer to extradite him to the States for testimony. Kent escaped before her arrival. At that time, professional killers were sent to search for Kent with the help of Mr. Green Village after bribing him. It started a fatal game of hide and seek among Kent, Cindy, the police and their killers..

programme.title: 旺角的天空3終極邊緣
programme.desc: Street boy Qian Jidong had been idolizing Pujun, one of the 'Double Eagles in Mong Kok' since childhood. His father was beaten because he owed Xiyang a loan, so Qian Jidong went to Xiyang desperately, but was captured by Xiyang. At a critical moment, Pujun appeared and saved his life. Then, Qian Jidong worked for Pujun. But Qian Jidong's girlfriend GIGI did not like him working in the underworld and finally broke up with him..

programme.title: 吳三桂與陳圓圓
programme.desc: Chan Tai Yuen had planned to migrate to Canada, he found out that his wife was having an affair with a foreigner. Chan had already transferred the ownership of the house and the car to his wife. Suddenly Chan lost everything. Chan met Ng Sam Kwi, Chan had nowhere to go and thus moved into Ng's house. They gradually fell in love with each other. Would Ng change herself for her love.

programme.title: 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned Chinese martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon..

programme.title: 暴風眼
programme.desc: Few years ago, Sergeant Kong in a mission to capture the head of the “East Rail Corporation” met with Yip Fung who killed the head of East Rail instead. Kong shot at Yip but missed and only a finger was left in the scene. Kong suspected that Yip might be a robot and thus kept a close watch on her, but later turned that he fell in love with Yip. One night, Ko Kit accompanied with four assistants launched a campaign to steal the “Crystal” in East Rail Main Building. Ko was successful in breaking through the security system and got the crystal but at the same time Yip also rushed to join in the robbery..

programme.title: 旺角卡門
programme.desc: A low-level trial 'big brother' has a hot-tempered 'littler brother' who can't keep out of trouble, and consequently is in constant need of being bailed out by his protector..

programme.title: 世上「母」難事: 告別有情天
programme.desc: The film was set in the 1970s, Dai Cheng-wah was a top law student in the University of Hong Kong. He fell in love with an orphan Suk-fun. His father opposed this relationship. The lovers eventually got married and Suk-fun dropped out of school because of pregnancy. Cheng-wah continued his studies and graduated. Under his father's influence, he was only able to work in a shabby law firm. After Suk-fun gave birth to triplets, Cheng-wah had a heavy burden. Finally, Cheng-wah won lawsuit and gained fame. However, Suk-fun suddenly discovered she had terminal illness..

programme.title: 西遊記之月光寶盒
programme.desc: At the foothills of Fingers Mountain, there is one Highwaymen's Haven, operating as a motel. The gang leader is a fellow named The Joker, and the gang makes a living out of robbing the traveling businessmen and scholars. The Joker is in fact Monkey King reincarnated. Grandpa Buddha is the only God who knows about this. Two of the devils, Spider Woman and Boney M, took the guise of Sharon Stone and Madonna and wooed him into betraying this secret. The two devils decided to get the Joker out of the way so that they could capture the Longevity Monk when the time came for his reincarnation..

programme.title: 知法犯法
programme.desc: Police constable Mike is suspended from duty charged with abusing the use of his gun in a robbery. During his suspension from duty, Mike meets a Triad Society Big Brother, Tin, and admires his lifestyle and also his sexy wife. Mike is apparently dismissed but in fact becoming a stoolie. Mike eventually becomes Tin's bodyguard, and discovers that his buddy Chung also becomes a stoolie. Mike uses the Police Force to get rid of all big brothers and intends to become the head of the Society, as well as taking over Tin's wife. For his own sake, Mike even kills his buddy Chung and kidnaps Tin..

Alex meets Vivian in the choir. However, Vivian's mother Chu Lai Ngo, a divorced woman who dislikes Alex at the first sight. When Alex and Chu are getting closer and closer, they imperceptibly fall in love with each other. At this moment, Peggy suddenly comes back to Alex asking for being together once again. Alex has to make his choice of love between these two women..

programme.title: BB30
programme.desc: Bau is a poor lawyer who has never won in litigation. He is a righteous guy but his unstable character brings him under disciplinary investigation, during which he meets a beautiful doctor, Cheng. However, since Cheng often deposes against Bau, misunderstanding and conflict grow between the two. On the other hand, Susan, an aerobic dancing instructor, has a deep passion for Bau for a long time and this makes Mo feel jealous and determine to go against him. As Bau and Mo go together, troubles and laughers are stirred up..

programme.title: 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned Chinese martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon..

programme.title: 摩登保鏢
programme.desc: Comedy trio the Hui Brothers' produce and star in this hilarious and off the wall laugh-fest and box-office hit, Security Unlimited. Michael Hui stars as head security guard Chou, whose unorthodox, and at times ridiculous approach to training his subordinates doesn't seem to go down well with his boss, Fan (Stanley Fung). Sam (Sam Hui) and Bruce (Ricky Hui) are Chou's favorite targets of abuse, but Chou soon finds the shoe is on the other foot when Ricky gets promoted after saving the day in a botched bank heist.

programme.title: 龍的傳人
programme.desc: Hung is a Kung-fu coach on Lautau Island. His son Lung and his fellow schoolmate, Mao, are considered a couple. One time, Hung's fellow Yan goes to Lautau for help. Lung knows Yan is not a good guy, however, Hung orders Lung to accompany with Yan to develop his career in the city. Yan discovers that Lung is a talented snooker-player and earns much money from gambling. But Lung loses Hung's land to a group of gangsters in game..

programme.title: 龍跨四海
programme.desc: SHIKO is brought up in a Japanese underworld family but lives with her mother in England after her parents' separation while her elder brother TARO stays with her father BUTA. In a business trip to Paris, SHIKO meets a Chinese illegal immigrant CHIN-SHUI who can only earn his living by working for the Chinatown triads. The stepping in of SHIKO brings a tremendous change to his life. After the assassination for the triads in Paris, CHIN-SHUI flees to England and stays with his Chinese friend, FA-CHIN, who always loves SHIKO. Both SHIKO and CHIN-SHUI fall in love. The company that SHIKO works for is owned by her father BUTA. Both BUTA and TARO discovers NAKAMURI's corrupt practices in their company..

programme.title: BB30
programme.desc: Bau is a poor lawyer who has never won in litigation. He is a righteous guy but his unstable character brings him under disciplinary investigation, during which he meets a beautiful doctor, Cheng. However, since Cheng often deposes against Bau, misunderstanding and conflict grow between the two. On the other hand, Susan, an aerobic dancing instructor, has a deep passion for Bau for a long time and this makes Mo feel jealous and determine to go against him. As Bau and Mo go together, troubles and laughers are stirred up..

programme.title: 絕世好Bra
programme.desc: Samantha, the president of a renowned brassiere company, breaks the tradition and hires two guys, Johnny and Wayne, as brassiere designers, and requires them to submit novel design in 3 months. Lena, is discontent with this decision deliberately make things difficult for them, those two newcomers to the brassiere industry thus act like buffoon. The time is coming. Can those two guys really work out the 'Ultimate Bra'.

programme.title: 絕世好B
programme.desc: Lena, Johnny and Wayne are commissioned to expand a new line of business specializing in merchandise for infants named 'Mighty Baby'. Johnny, enjoying his new perks as a supervising executive, hires a neurotic secretary Sabrina. Knowing that her boyfriend Wayne is a 'baby-phobic', Lena seeks help from Boey, an expert in child behavioral patterns..

programme.title: 雷霆特警
programme.desc: Zhao libing, an outstanding member of the Hong Kong special police force, was selected to attend special training in Seoul. During the training process, Bing met Li Ziping and Jin Yuqi, and instructor Zhang was very strict with them. After the graduation ceremony, Bing said goodbye to Qi and Ping and Cheng Zhengde sent her to the airport. They were busy with their jobs. Bing cracked a counterfeit banknote case in Hong Kong. One of the prisoners was willing to be a tainted witness and said that the mastermind was in South Korea. Bing accompanied with the Interpol to escort the tainted witness to Seoul..

programme.title: 黃蜂尾後針
programme.desc: When Yau argues with his wife Jessica for the uneven share of dirty money, he shoots her in coma. To find out the money, Yau hires Sister Ma to look after her..

programme.title: 世上「母」難事: 與龍共舞
programme.desc: Aaron, a young, successful Chinese businessman, drifts on to a rural island after a scuba accident. Mistaken for an illegal immigrant, he is forced to take refuge in a small, family-run grocery store. Enjoying the riches to rags transition, he tells nobody his true identity, and falls in love with the grocery store owner's daughter, Yvonne. But while Aaron enjoys his life of anonymity, Yvonne covets the chance to escape her poverty.

programme.title: 浪漫殺手自由人
programme.desc: After learning that his father was killed by the notorious Chinatown Triad, Nidaine becomes a cold-blooded killer determined to get his revenge. When one of his assassinations is witnessed by Jenny, Nidaine plans on silencing her forever. Instead, Nidaine finds himself falling for her, and they must now run for their lives from both the cops and the Triad assassins.

programme.title: 陽光警察
programme.desc: In order to enhance a fresh image, the police force selects O and Sammy as 'Sunshine Cops'. But the campaign is not met with the anticipated popularity..

Can those two guys really work out the 'Ultimate Bra'.

programme.title: 女黑俠黃鶯
programme.desc: Wong Ngung wants to help her adoptive father Yip Lei-yam to eradicate Lui Pao, an evildoer in the gang. But Lui Pao forestalls them; Yip and his daughter Mocking Bird are killed, and Wong loses her memory by a big hit. A sorceress and a girl Ah Ching save her. The two women think that Wong is a rich girl, so they treat her very well and hope for repayment. Ah Ching is in love with Ah Kat, a car-repairing worker. Her mother opposes it. Her mother also bears a great debt because of gambling.

programme.title: 情聖
programme.desc: Shing and Betty want to find money to pay back the loan shark. They break into a house and prepare to steal the valuable items in it. Old Bill, who also owes debts to the loan shark, happens to be in the house. He pretends to be the owner, because he thinks Shing is a wealthy man that he could cheat him for money. Eventually, they find out each other's real identity and cooperate to set plans and trap the loan shark.

programme.title: 半斤八兩
programme.desc: Joseph Wong (Michael Hui), the kingpin of the Manix Private Detective Agency, a firm believer in tact and thrift. By tact, he means you can cheat all the people all the time and corners are there to be cut. By thrift, he means an underpaid staff is happy and grateful staff. By chance, he employs Lee Kwok Kit (Samuel Hui). Together, they have solved lots of wired cases. One day, while the two are investigating a blackmail case, the movie goes off and the lights come on. Scores of gun-toting hoods hold the more than 1,000 goers as hostages. On the stage Uncle Gaw (Shek Kin) threatens that it is a hold-up.

programme.title: 一觸即發
programme.desc: After police detective Lau is ambushed and killed, his best friend Pitt vows to get the killer. A series of investigation follows. Pitt finally finds an eyewitness to the killing - Fat Goose who is persuaded to testify against the killer Lam Man Fu. Lam Man Fu chases and attacks Pitt and Fat Goose. Finally, Pitt arrests him but Superintendent Keung frees Lam Man Fu and removes Pitt from the case. Then Lam Man Fu firebombs Fat Goose's residence. Fat Goose moves into Pitt's home and strikes a fast friendship with Angel, Pitt's reporter sister..

programme.desc: Summer flies to an island to sell a resort that is invested by her and her cousin. She meets Momocha who claims to be the authentic owner of the hotel. They begin a battle of love..

programme.title: 縱橫四海
programme.desc: A trio of art burglars Joe, Jim & Cherie were orphans raised by Mr Chow and trained into pretty thieves. But they advanced to the big time. Stealing paintings proved to be most lucrative..

programme.title: 新仙鶴神針
programme.desc: While the world of martial arts is in probably the most peaceful period for a long while, the Tien Lung Tribe suddenly emerges with a strong military presence as if it were to conquer the warring society. As its presence begin to stir up everyone in the scene, the Court decides to order the leader of the Six Fan Gates – Cho Hung to gather the ten most esteemed tribes for a conference in an attempt to prevent any chaos or unnecessary warfare in the community..

programme.title: 心動
programme.desc: Ho-jun is a shy youngster, more interested in his guitar than school. A chance encounter between Ho-jun and Sheo-rou leads to a first sweet taste of romance. However..

programme.title: 驅魔警察
programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. Lam explained that the 'Stewardess' had actually been killed before she came back to Hong Kong. She had been turned to be a living corpse and controlled by a Japanese magician for smuggling..

programme.title: 生死拳速
programme.desc: Retired veteran CHAU and his six-year-old son DONG DONG play cheerfully at a park. Suddenly, a couple shows up with their bodyguards. The woman has stayed with CHAU while pregnant, but later left him for a rich tycoon CHIU. Today, they come to get their son. Helplessly, CHAU watches them take away the crying child. He swears to bring him back. CHEUK is captain of a mainland security team. One day, CHEUK picks up his nephew after school as usual. Yet, the school is surrounded by the police. In fact, CHAU has taken students' hostage demanding to see his son. Or, he will bomb the school..

programme.title: 世上「母」難事: 同居蜜友
programme.desc: Tung Choi is the third-generation shop owner of a string of beef noodle restaurants. He gets into a minor fender bender with the hard working, yet outwardly mean Deborah. The two engage in an ill-tempered spat which makes both characters seem completely unlikable. Meeting later to negotiate a truce, the two end up engaging in a one-night stand, but a happy ending is far from possible. Tung is linked to high-maintenance TV personality Mindy, and Deborah is about to encounter a fitting fall from grace. Thanks to her mean-spirited behavior, she loses her job, her home (she and her father have a spat), and possibly her self-respect. Deborah and Tung encounter each other at the hospital, where Tung is visiting his mother and Deborah is staying (as in sleeping on the floor) with her sister. Tung offers to let her freshen up at his home, but she ends up sleeping on the couch for a short period of time. Tung's extremely weird family seems against Deborah; they tout Mindy's positive p.

programme.title: 明月照尖東
programme.desc: Police detective Ming loses his gun during a drunken binge and attempts to recover it while romancing PR girl Tweedy. That's the gist of the first two-thirds of the slackly-paced story, which is enlivened by a gun battle, a chase on foot through speeding cars, and comic relief provided by Ming's partner. Things really heat up, though, when Tweedy's old boyfriend Prince, a psychotic killer, comes back to town..

programme.title: 油尖少爺

Therefore, she dressed up to work in the nightclub in order to make her dad mad. A gangster had an interest in Baby, but fortunately Cong came forward to help. Baby and Cong developed feelings for each other. Baby used her wealth to help Cong with his career, but when Cong found out that his career was helped by Baby secretly, it was difficult for him to accept. How should Cong decide.

programme.desc: May's from a broken family. Her step father abused her and her mother, and even made her to be a cabaret hostess. Then she fell in love with a bank manager however the love couldn't last; Gigi's husband was in jail. She became a hostess to raise money to get him out. Her husband was out but started to cheat on her; Porsche knew her best days were over as a hostess. She had been saving money for going to US to see her daughter. One day her ex-boyfriend came back from US and..

programme.title: 癲佬正傳
programme.desc: Social worker Fun specializes in counseling psychotics. Writer Yip is inspired by his mission and decides to work with him. One day, Fung is accidentally killed by a patient..

programme.title: 鍾無艷
programme.desc: On his hunting trip, Emperor Qi takes a wrong turn and is confronted by bandit leader/wild beauty Wu Yen. The two are immediately attracted to each other. However, an ugly mole on Wu Yen's face thwarts this match made in heaven. Emperor Qi cancels the wedding for fear of marrying someone ugly. The mole is the result of a 'love spell' put by enchantress Yin Chun, who is actually an incarnation of a 3000-years old fox with great magical power..

programme.title: 痴情快婿
programme.desc: Leon busts an international drug ring at Singapore in a startling fight sequence that will shock even the most jaded filmgoer. From there on it's laughs galore when Leon arrives on Hong Kong with his wife to be who is then kidnapped by her own father who objects to her marrying a police officer. Frankie Chan immediately comes to the aid of his long time friend and in a series of exciting sequences they pursue Leon's missing fiance. Together they encounter her father's bumbling gangster, the vivaciously devious Sharon Kwok, and a team of deadly western agents sent to destroy them. In an explosive finale laughter takes a backseat to tension as the two battle overwhelming odds and just when all appears lost Frankie comes to the rescue.

programme.title: 天涯海角
programme.desc: Kelly, suffers from leukemia, encounters a sailor named Michael who comes from the North Sea of Scotland. Love comes and goes until Takeshi comes to her life..
