programme.desc: Saint Hero is renowned for robbing the rich and giving to the poor. They uphold justice and fight crime. Che Hoi is head of Saint Hero with his odd couple daughters, Sim Lan and May as his assistants. All of them are excellent martial arts fighters. Without any trace of Saint Hero, Special Unit of the Police Force send their smartest man, Lethal Weapon, to cooperate with the most intelligent police woman, Super Canon. Another capable but odd couple swear to put Saint Hero to jail. However, they are the most capable but ‘destructive' police. All places that were under their investigation are badly ruined..

programme.title: 阿金
programme.desc: Ah Kam is from Mainland China and is trained in kung fu. She becomes a double in Hong Kong. Tung and his partners of the Tung's Family, a stunt man group, cannot work as stuntmen after an ambush. Tung lets Kam try being the stunt director and Kam becomes very popular. Kam married Sam and moves to Shenzhen to look after Sam's karaoke business. However, being a karaoke manager does not suit Kam. At the same time, Sam is unfaithful and so Kam returns to the movie industry and once again becomes a stuntwoman..

programme.title: 帶子洪郎
programme.desc: Hung is a stuntman living with his troublesome father, Kwun. Five years ago, he deeply fell in love with May. Yet May's father strongly objected their relations and separated them trickily, with the help of Kwun. One day, May come backs - but with her six-year-old son, Sam. He begins to get back what he loses five years ago. May actually been badly ill before she comes back Hong Kong. Her only wish before die is to bring Sam back to Hung. After May has died, May's father insists to keep Sam by his sides. Hung tries his best to get back Sam. In order to earn more money, he does a very dangerous stunt. At last, he is injured..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 買兇拍人
programme.desc: Hong Kong is an over-crowded city, where people are easily provoked with confilcts. Hitman BART and assistant director CHUEN offer a bargain package 'YOU SHOOT, I SHOOT'.

programme.title: 世上「母」難事: 烈火戰車2極速傳說
programme.desc: After winning yet another race, the underground drag car racer king, Sky, was framed by his rival's brother Fung. On the run in Thailand, Sky hooks up with his long lost father, himself a legendary racer, who steers his son back on course for the ultimate showdown of speed with Fung.

programme.title: 殺手的童話
programme.desc: Judge was one of the top killers of ICE's syndicate. Mr. Tung Fai, a super cop attempted to sue the Triad head, Godfather “Tiger”. Unfortunately, his witness gave false testimony. Worst still, the witness was shot by Judge who impersonated as the presiding Judge in the law court. Meanwhile, Judge met Ru-fung, sister of Ice and both fell in love. The two killers understood they could not have true love. They decided to enjoy love for 3 days, and then separate and return to their killing carrier again.

programme.title: 致命性騷擾
programme.desc: Office worker Amy goes berserk and tries to stab her boss, Cheuk, accusing him of sexual harassment and rape. The higher-ups accept Amy's description of the event and Cheuk is suspended, in spite of the fact that in-house lawyer Joe believes the man is innocent..

programme.title: 一蚊雞保鑣
programme.desc: Bon Bon, a resident of Tuen Mun, who's always attempting to implement his latest pyramid scheme. Bon Bon rescues a lady from a lecher occasionally and decides to implement his latest scheme, 'One Dollar Bodyguard'. He'll protect women on their evening strolls for one HK dollar. Bon Bon has to attend to his own problem, which is his inability to ride in a moving vehicle, that strands him in Tuen Mun for life. And there's the romantic issue with Snooker to resolve..

programme.title: 女機械人
programme.desc: Selina, a beautiful female cop, who is assigned to bodyguard a middle eastern prince who is staying in Hong Kong. But then, a mad scientist who has transferred his mind into a cyborge which looks human comes and kills Selina, then kidnaps the prince and holds him for ransom. To save the prince and stop the evil scientist-turned killer cyborge, good scientist Dr. Sara and her cyborge assistant Ann transfer Selina's mind into the body of a cyborge that looks just like her. Now Selina, Ann, Dr. Sara and Selina's cop fiance, who has been told Selina survived the shooting and doesn't know she's a cyborge now, must team up to defeat the bad guy..

programme.title: 影人映語 -大哥大唔易做 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: Sammo Hung, who was honoured with the 42th Hong Kong Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award for his contribution to the film industry for over half a century, has been active both on and off screen. Switching roles among action-choreographer, director, actor and all over on set, he consistently produces acclaimed film from time to time. In this episode, the 'Big Big Brother' will talk about his multiple roles in the field and struggle story of Sammo Hung Stunt Team.

programme.title: 林世榮
programme.desc: Lam sai-wing is the mischievous student of Wong Fei-hung. His eagerness to help others often lands himself in some precarious situations. He mistakenly befriends the only son of Master Kao from the Five Dragons School who then frames him for the murder of his God sister. Master Kao upon hearing his God daughter and his only son's death seeks Wing to avenger their cruel death..

programme.title: 我在黑社會的日子

Mun-ho, who did not want to mingle with the mobsters, planned to return to the States for good after wrapping up his father's business in Hong Kong. However, through his intelligence and managerial skills, he turned Hung Hing into a well organized business structure. On the other hand, Yeung Kong, a young and ambitious mobster who was brought up under the old Triad tradition, strongly opposed Mun-ho..

programme.title: 皇家師姐IV之直擊証人
programme.desc: A detective of the Anti-Narcotics Bureau is pursued for a film he snapped containing evidence of drug-trafficking between a CIA and Hong Kong drug traffickers. Before death, he hands the film over to a Hong Kong immigrant, a pier coolie Luk, who throws it away when the killer arrives. Hong Kong police Madam Yeung assigned to help the local police to investigate the case witnesses Luk killing a killer of the Intelligence Agency but concludes that he is innocent and did it out of defense only. Local detective Donnie and his sidekick Michael Wong are responsible for probing the murder, and when Luk escapes to Hong Kong, Donnie and Yeung immediately to Hong Kong to trace him. Donnie and Michael are also under orders to have him arrested and extradited to the USA. However, Luk and Michael have already been and abducted by the crafty killer..

programme.title: 江湖告急
programme.desc: The word is out: underworld kingpin Jimmy Yam will be killed in a day. He has a chance to see who the people around him really are and finds out who is behind the assassination..

programme.title: 男歌女唱
programme.desc: Chu Wai Tak is a natural born introvert, a white collar worker who suffers from a serious lack of self confidence. Her greatest achievement at work is 'using 10% less toilet paper than yesterday' and saving several more cents. King's self confidence is at its peak as he has crowned himself the King of Karaoke. He becomes exhausted if he does not go to the karaoke box and sing for a few days. King loves to gain attention at the company and has indeed brought a lot of energy to a boring company..

programme.title: 不死情謎
programme.desc: Sam and his team are members of a Serious Crime Unit in the District Crime Squad, conducting a crackdown on an international crime organization trafficking in the human cargo of illegal immigrants. The team successfully dissolves the group and destroys its power in Southeast Asia. They arrest one of the group's leaders, Night. At the court, Night is charged with several offences and is being prosecuted by Sam's fiancee, Ann. Ann tries her best to convict Night for all the crimes he committed. However, the defense lawyer is tough and manipulative and finally, Night is convicted on only one of the charges in human smuggling and sentenced to three years imprisonment. Night is unrepentant and vows to take his revenge and destroy the couple one day. During the lawyer's visit, Night relays this message to his brother, Day, and asks Day to carry out the revenge for him..

When martial arts master Wong Kay-ying arrives, his martial arts skills lead local lawmen to suspect that he may be the masked outlaw. Wong's son, Wong Fei-hung, is caught in the line of fire as he fights to clear his name. In the end, Wong and the Iron Monkey must join forces to face the real villain of the piece.

He is suffering until he comes across the school teacher Miss Ho. Sing's school life is thus painted with more colours. Finally, Sing settles every problem and succeeds in finding the lost gun. At the Same Time, he destorys a munition smuggling activity. This leads the smugglers to school to take revenge. A group of students is being kept hostage. Sing shows his true colour by saving all the students. This not only wins his students' admiration but also Miss Ho's heart.

Nothing is beyond these fighting women as they enter the Golden triangle unafraid because they are on a “MISSION OF JUSTICE”! Through the jungle they pursue the dangerous Yie Feng as they track her into the very heart of Cala. Working under-cover they both find their lives at risk to the deadly Drug Lords. Only their superior fighting skills can keep them from being killed..

He is so busy making money. Ah Chi is a postman believing in fung shui. Ah Hark is an apprentice in his family jewelry shop and Ah Wai failed in public exam. Ah Ming is the most unconventional of the five. Working in a Japanese restaurant. The five start a laundry shop which soon folds. Next, they try something new to save their business. Ah Ming leads a carefree life which dismays his girl, Yoko. Ah Hark's girlfriend Cat will move to Australia and leave him soon. Ah Ming and Ah Hark are going to lose their girlfriends. The five new generation are going their own ways..

programme.desc: Buck trails two suspicious men and jumps into action to foil their plans. Soon after he meets Liu, who convinces Buck that he may be the long-lost son of a rich korean businessman..

programme.title: 上海之夜
programme.desc: In 1937, Tung, a young soldier, meet Shu under the Soochow Bridge, Shanghai, where they have been sheltering from the bombing of the city by Japanese planes. In the semi-darkness, though unable to see each other clearly, the young couple experience an immediate attraction towards each other, and plan how to meet again when the war is over..

programme.title: 賣身契
programme.desc: The contract is a piece of almost blank paper by which MTV binds all its employees to eight years of impecunious service. Chi-Man, an aspiring but frustrated artist, hates the contract since he is given no chance of getting ahead. He constantly thinks of moving to greener pastures. His brother Chi-Ying is a self-made investor who has just come up with a laugh bomb. By chance, Chi-Man becomes the host of a Cat TV program. With the aid of the laugh bomb, he becomes an instant success, yet..

programme.title: 江湖接班人
programme.desc: Sammy is a man of honour. He lives by the underworld's code of honour. He helps friends and kills enemies, for instance, Ng Kong who got him 3 years behind bars. Sammy is now a fugitive in Taiwan being protected by Kui, one of the gang leaders. Once Kui injures Peter, his opposition and young Crow takes the rap. Sammy and Crow become friends. Sammy tries to mediate between Kui and Peter but finds out being used by Kui to eliminate Peter. He wants out. But Crow joins Kui's gang after killing Peter. Sammy retires to Crow's home town and falls in love with his sister. Kui begins to turn against Crow. He sends Crow to Hong Kong and orders to kill him. Crow escapes back to Taiwan, only to find his girlfriend has committed suicide after Kui's gang has raped her. At the same moment, Kui's men come for him and kill his sister who comes with Sammy to deliver their wedding news. With Sammy by his side, Crow starts his vendetta..

programme.title: 黑俠II
programme.desc: Black Mask is back as he tries to find a cure for the genetic mutation that gives him superhuman powers. However, he finds trouble with a demented scientist, Moloch, who uses a group of pro wrestlers in his experiment to combine animal DNA with human DNA. Things get worse when Black Mask's arch nemesis, Lang, has plans of his own involving Moloch and his mutants..

programme.title: 雙城故事
programme.desc: After having grown up to lead wildly separate lives, two reunited boyhood pals pledge to maintain their friendship at all costs but both fall in love with the same woman.

programme.title: Yes一族
programme.desc: Five young men threw themselves with heart and soul into the work force. They have different approaches and different life styles. Ah Kit is the hardworking investment broker. He is so busy making money. Ah Chi is a postman believing in fung shui. Ah Hark is an apprentice in his family jewelry shop and Ah Wai failed in public exam. Ah Ming is the most unconventional of the five. Working in a Japanese restaurant. The five start a laundry shop which soon folds. Next, they try something new to save their business. Ah Ming leads a carefree life which dismays his girl, Yoko. Ah Hark's girlfriend Cat will move to Australia and leave him soon. Ah Ming and Ah Hark are going to lose their girlfriends. The five new generation are going their own ways..

programme.title: 戀戰沖繩
programme.desc: Jenny wakes up and decides to leave her lover Sato, a triad boss. She takes Sato's ransom money to Tang, who has a diary with explicit details of Sato's triad activities.

programme.title: 賣身契
programme.desc: The contract is a piece of almost blank paper by which MTV binds all its employees to eight years of impecunious service. Chi-Man, an aspiring but frustrated artist, hates the contract since he is given no chance of getting ahead. He constantly thinks of moving to greener pastures. His brother Chi-Ying is a self-made investor who has just come up with a laugh bomb. By chance, Chi-Man becomes the host of a Cat TV program. With the aid of the laugh bomb, he becomes an instant success, yet..

programme.title: 英雄本色
programme.desc: Tse-Ho works for the Triad, the deal in Taiwan turns out to be a trap by the Taiwanese gang. A shootout ensues in which Ho and Shing flee, pursued by local law enforcement. Ho's father is killed, he pleads with Kit to forgive his brother. Ho is released from prison three years later. Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. Ho spots Mark during one of his shifts; in contrast to Mark's letters, he realizes that Mark has been reduced to an errand boy for Shing (who is the new leader of the Triad). During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. Consequently, Shing begins harassing Ho in order to get him to return, including luring Kit into a trap and injuring Kit, attacking Ho's co-workers, and hav.

programme.title: 繼續跳舞
programme.desc: Chang and Ao are twin sisters. Ao is a lunatic and stays in a mental hospital. Chang is 'cheated' into the hospital, exchanging identity with her insane sister. The mad house is lived by all kinds of weirdos. The 'game' is that Chang will stay in the hospital only for a while. But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over..

programme.title: 黑俠II
programme.desc: Black Mask is back as he tries to find a cure for the genetic mutation that gives him superhuman powers. However, he finds trouble with a demented scientist, Moloch, who uses a group of pro wrestlers in his experiment to combine animal DNA with human DNA. Things get worse when Black Mask's arch nemesis, Lang, has plans of his own involving Moloch and his mutants..

programme.title: 月黑風高
programme.desc: Michael Chow is the chief cop of Tai O, a small rural town on Hong Kong's outlying Lantau Island. When a local man turns up dead, urban hero cop Michael Wong is sent in to help out the locals... and what follows is a cultural clash that's both humorous and utterly entertaining! Wong is an SDU cop and takes to bullying the locals with tough and hard-handed ways, but his efforts only result in resentment and anger. It's Chow who gets what the odd residents of Tai O are about, and his lackadaisical attitude is just what's needed to handle the prickly locals. But it may take the skills of both men to solve this murder case! Though nominally a cop film, this unique creation is as much a comedy of cultural errors as a murder mystery.

programme.title: 霹靂大喇叭
programme.desc: Tuba is a policeman, but because of his timid character, he spends his days in the Police Band as a tuba player. Inspector Chow sees the potential in Tuba and arranges him to investigate the case together. Unfortunately, Chow gets killed at work, but his ghost helps Tuba to crackdown on the villains..

programme.title: 賭聖2之街頭賭聖
programme.desc: Lui puts forward a masked Saint of gamblers to cover for him in the casino. Meanwhile, Uncle Sam sets out in search of the new Saint since the real saint of gamblers retires..

programme.title: 小男人周記
programme.desc: Leung Foon is one of those youthful, upward-moving people. He is 33, middle rung officer of an advertising agency, and has been married eight years to Ann. Ann holds down a key post in a finance company. She also likes to manage Foon's life. The couple has been drifting apart. A quarrel and the two decide to separate. Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro..

programme.title: 蠍子戰士
programme.desc: Fei comes to Hong Kong with his son Yushu and winds up a back-alley barber. Yushu is now in high school but he only likes to draw pictures. He also is hot blooded, thus often getting into fights. By accident, Yushu meets beautiful Ru. He learns that Inspector Hua and underworld boss Wang are working together in prostitution and human traffic. Yushu helps Ru to escape from Wang 's catches. Fei, Yushu and Ru are being haunted by Hua's men, but are saved by self-styled kungfu master Jean-Paul. They are taken in by Master Yi and asks Yushu to prepare the beef noodles but he only wants to learn kungfu from Jean-Paul. However, Yushu realizes Master Yi actually is the kungfu master. He begs Master Yi to teach him the skills and fight against evil forces together..

programme.title: 想飛
programme.desc: When Joker meets Ling in a disco one night, he feels she is the perfect model of his dream project 'princess-d'. In reality, however, Ling is the opposite of the perfect image..

programme.title: 風雨同路
programme.desc: Undercover cop Cheung Long is instructed to take up the identity as convict to get acquainted to Lee Wan Fay who is a stolen goods dealer. In the course of escaping from Big Mad, an opponent of Fay, both Long and Fay grow a good feeling towards each other. When Long's supervisor wants to use Fay to bait Big Mad, Long saves Fay and tells him the truth..

programme.title: 太子傳說
programme.desc: Cheung is Prince, the son of crime boss Mr. Pak in the underworld. He kills flamboyantly with the help of partner Ching Ching, who was a gift from Mr. Pak many years ago. Still, despite Ching's constant companionship, Prince longs for a woman he has seen in his dreams since youth. The dream girl is a dancer Tweedy. He also longs to kill Drago, who was supposedly responsible for taking his mother away. Dragon actually has his own vendetta against Pak, as Pak kidnapped his son many years ago. The missing son turns up, and he's now a killer who goes by the name of Prince.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: 賽門李維野性之旅 第1季
programme.desc: Simon Reeve battles his way across the Congo, braving thick jungle and tropical swamps in search of the people and the wildlife who make their home in Africa's greatest rainforest.

programme.title: 文明世界: 崛起與殞落 第1季
programme.desc: For 250 years Japan has thrived, largely cut off from the west - until US gunboats arrive.

programme.title: 亞歷山大的印度歷險記 第1季
programme.desc: Alexander begins in Mumbai, riding the city's gleaming new metro before venturing into a forest with the world's highest concentration of leopards. From there, he heads to Bangalore, India's tech capital, where the future and tradition sit side by side.

programme.title: 食品工廠 第2季
programme.desc: Discover how the makers of madras sambar, an ancient Indian vegetable stew, manage to fit an entire aromatic meal into a small can; the surprisingly sumptuous combo of lemony chocolate and cottage cheese is molded into Moo Moo bars, a modern update of a frozen Russian treat.

programme.title: 食品工廠 第2季
programme.desc: Discover how irresistibly flaky sausage rolls were formerly a snack fit for just a king; fluffy, sugary Peeps marshmallows come out looking like adorable baby chicks; bright colored Candy Tree lollipops get their sweet and sour flavor.

programme.title: 賽門李維野性之旅 第1季
programme.desc: Simon Reeve battles his way across the Congo, braving thick jungle and tropical swamps in search of the people and the wildlife who make their home in Africa's greatest rainforest.

programme.title: 瓊安娜的多瑙河之旅: 歐洲巨河 第1季
programme.desc: Joanna heads towards the Danube Delta, one of the last great wilderness areas remaining in Europe, full of birdlife including the majestic Pelican. At the mouth of the river, on Romania's Black Sea coast, Joanna bids farewell to the Danube and reflects on her amazing journey.

programme.title: 食品工廠 第2季
programme.desc: Discover how smooth caramel and milky chocolate combine with pretzels to produce a perfect salty sweet snack; the makers of Jelly Bellys get those mouth-watering flavours into their jellybeans; lip-smacking Korean dumplings are jam-packed with savory spices and healthy veggies.

programme.title: 食品工廠 第2季
programme.desc: Discover how sweet and crunchy Boston Baked Beans are made to be the candy version of a traditional side dish; the tangy strawberry filling in a Welch's fruit yogurt snack receives a creamy coating; brocato, a cheesy Scottish breakfast pie, gets its stand up pastry shell.

programme.title: 史提夫勇闖鯨豚王國 第1季
programme.desc: Steve encounters the largest and most sophisticated hunters on the planet, revealing how the ingenious strategies used by whales can sometimes get these extraordinary predators in trouble.

programme.title: 蘇柏金斯大冒險: 巴黎到伊斯坦堡 第1季
programme.desc: In Paris, Sue samples insects and absinthe, models for Paris Fashion Week, and crashes a cabaret.

programme.title: 古文明帝國崛起 第1季
programme.desc: In a brutal world where nature is both friend and foe, our ancient powers are just beginning, they must use all their skill and ingenuity to shape their territory and establish their cultures.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: Seven celebrities face a challenging expedition in the South African bush, where they must learn to navigate difficult terrain, build shelters, make fire and eat the food that nature provides. From being suspended by rope from a helicopter to eating mopane worms and navigating through scorched plains, the stars face a range of tough tasks and Bear himself eliminates one of them after each challenge. Actor Neil Morrissey, choreographer Jason Gardiner, women's footballer Alex Scott, actresses Michelle Collins and Chelsee Healey, West End star Samantha Barks and former footballer Stuart Pearce make up the team.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: Neil Morrissey, Jason Gardiner, Alex Scott, Michelle Collins, Chelsee Healey, Samantha Barks and Stuart Pearce continue their expedition through the South African bush - or at least, six of them do, after one was eliminated last week. Their next mission involves locating their next meal - a dead springbok in the Karoo mountains. The only problem is, to get it back they have to divide it into pieces and carry it in their rucksacks across ropes suspended 50ft above a rocky ravine. Anyone who fails.

programme.title: Get Out Alive with Bear Grylls 第1季
programme.desc: With a low morale at camp, the teams must work together to safely rappel down a dangerous cliff, and face their coldest night thus far. With Robin and Wilson gone, the teams find a new pace, and realize an even playing field translates to stiffer competition.

programme.title: Jack Stein: In The Box 第1季
programme.desc: Jack learns about Britain’s history with ice cream and the famous spotted dick dessert. Then, he heads to Rotterdam where he meets the dessert’s Dutch cousin.

programme.title: Jack Stein: In The Box 第1季
programme.desc: Jack takes the classic roast beef and Yorkshire pudding to Cape Town. There, he meets a friend and they source seasonal summer veg and make a South African beef roast.

programme.title: Jade Fever 第6季
programme.desc: Robin uncovers a massive jade lens at Two Mile, but it might be too big for their small operation to dig out.

programme.title: Jade Fever 第6季
programme.desc: When a freak August snowstorm strands Claudia and Robin at Two Mile, Gary and Garon try to save the day by driving through the storm to bring them supplies but they wind up needing rescuing themselves.

programme.title: Jade Fever 第6季
programme.sub-title: Between a Truck and a Hard Place
programme.desc: Robin makes a difficult decision about his beloved mine truck 6-Pack after another expensive breakdown, while Claudia makes a desperate call for help to get their jade out of camp before winter shuts them down.

programme.title: Jade Fever 第6季
programme.desc: With winter closing in, Claudia pushes her exhausted crew to their breaking point, causing tempers to flare and forcing Claudia to finally take one for the team.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: Showdown of the Unbeatables 第1季
programme.desc: Episode 107 of Showdown of the Unbeatables features Adapt Laser versus the Chemsol Randogrip supercoating; JetCat engine versus the Jet-O-Vator personal watercraft; and Power Post Driver versus the Baker Ballistics riot shield.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第1季
programme.desc: It may be the backpacker's must-see, but if you go to the Venice of the East, don't drive.

programme.title: Heavy Load 第1季
programme.desc: Heavy transport in the rainforest. For the Sao Manoel hydroelectric power plant in the heart of Brazil, massive elements have to be delivered over a long and arduous route. The transformers weigh more than 200 tonnes each - the way to the destination, almost 4000 kilometres. Heat, dust and dirt roads that are completely dry and full of bumps. The journey becomes dangerous, sometimes it's a matter of centimetres. Then comes the river crossing - with more than 200 tonnes of cargo. The current is unhurried, but what the river swallows is lost. The transport takes seven weeks and delays cost money, breakdowns cost a lot of money - mistakes must not be made here.

programme.desc: Heavy transport in the rainforest. For the Sao Manoel hydroelectric power plant in the heart of Brazil, massive elements have to be delivered over a long and arduous route. The transformers weigh more than 200 tonnes each - the way to the destination, almost 4000 kilometres. Heat, dust and dirt roads that are completely dry and full of bumps. The journey becomes dangerous, sometimes it's a matter of centimetres. Then comes the river crossing - with more than 200 tonnes of cargo. The current is unhurried, but what the river swallows is lost. The transport takes seven weeks and delays cost money, breakdowns cost a lot of money - mistakes must not be made here.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: The Force of Nature 2022 第1季
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第1季

Whether making sure we have the right ingredients for our favorite meals, or getting the boats brushed up and ready for action, the day before can be just as important as the day of.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第1季
programme.desc: Tune in as Jean-Paul and the crew share their first day full day at duck camp with a morning in the duck blind and catfish on the jug line. At the end of the day they put their Cajun grocery goods together for an epic duck camp meal.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: Billy Goes North 第1季
programme.desc: Billy and his partner Derick remove a nest of snakes from a houseboat, then he responds to a storage facility where some deer-elk hybrids are threatening to injure clients.

programme.title: Billy Goes North 第1季
programme.desc: Billy responds to a construction site where a vicious varmint has the tradespeople running scared. Then Billy and Bea investigate a haunted house to find the source of some strange noises.

programme.title: Jade Fever 第6季
programme.desc: Robin uncovers a massive jade lens at Two Mile, but it might be too big for their small operation to dig out.

programme.title: Jade Fever 第6季
programme.desc: When a freak August snowstorm strands Claudia and Robin at Two Mile, Gary and Garon try to save the day by driving through the storm to bring them supplies but they wind up needing rescuing themselves.

programme.title: Jade Fever 第6季
programme.sub-title: Between a Truck and a Hard Place
programme.desc: Robin makes a difficult decision about his beloved mine truck 6-Pack after another expensive breakdown, while Claudia makes a desperate call for help to get their jade out of camp before winter shuts them down.

programme.title: Jade Fever 第6季
programme.desc: With winter closing in, Claudia pushes her exhausted crew to their breaking point, causing tempers to flare and forcing Claudia to finally take one for the team.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Face the Wild 第1季
programme.desc: Survival expert Bear Grylls takes real people who inspire him into the wild. On the series premiere, Jennifer, a glamper mom of four - two of which have down syndrome - learns camping skills to impress her outdoor-loving family while Bear learns about her international quest that helped save lives.

programme.title: Heavy Load 第1季
programme.desc: Heavy transport in the rainforest. For the Sao Manoel hydroelectric power plant in the heart of Brazil, massive elements have to be delivered over a long and arduous route. The transformers weigh more than 200 tonnes each - the way to the destination, almost 4000 kilometres. Heat, dust and dirt roads that are completely dry and full of bumps. The journey becomes dangerous, sometimes it's a matter of centimetres. Then comes the river crossing - with more than 200 tonnes of cargo. The current is unhurried, but what the river swallows is lost. The transport takes seven weeks and delays cost money, breakdowns cost a lot of money - mistakes must not be made here.

programme.title: Get Out Alive with Bear Grylls 第1季
programme.desc: With a low morale at camp, the teams must work together to safely rappel down a dangerous cliff, and face their coldest night thus far. With Robin and Wilson gone, the teams find a new pace, and realize an even playing field translates to stiffer competition.

programme.desc: Sara travels to Darwin, visiting markets and experiencing the local culture and delicacies, discovering strong influences from Asia.

programme.desc: Sara goes to Kakadu in the Northern Territory to learn about the Indigenous traditions of the area, including the wild herbs they use in their cooking.

programme.title: Get Out Alive with Bear Grylls 第1季
programme.desc: The contestants are helicoptered to the top of a glacier, where they must navigate unforgiving terrain and dangerous crevasses. With high altitudes and fewer resources, the tasks become more demanding. Divided, the four remaining teams compete for a spot in the final journey.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A 44-ton Artic straddling the central reservation of the M1 is a rush hour headache for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve and one of the youngest Recovery Ops on the team, Pat. Down South, Lantern Recovery op Steve rescues a broken down 26-ton dustcart from a busy London street. Crouch Recovery op Jim gets drenched as he risks life and limb trying to get a broken-down tractor back to its farm – just a hundred yards away! And Lantern’s night shift recovery op Jason faces a battle to rescue an articulated lorry that’s crashed down a steep ditch off the A1.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: An overturned Gas tanker full of highly flammable propane mean trouble for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve. Working with the fire service he must all his experience to keep his team out of danger. Meanwhile with very little room to manoeuvre Lantern recovery op Steve must rescue a 44-ton artic stuck in a ditch on a busy five lane roundabout. And Lantern Recovery Op Sean has thought on his feet to break into an abandoned truck.

programme.title: David Attenborough A Life on Earth 第1季
programme.sub-title: David Attenborough: A Life on Earth
programme.desc: The incredible journey and illustrious career of one of the most travelled men in history, this documentary tells the story of how Sir David Attenborough came to be the voice of modern natural history programs by bringing the natural world into our homes.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: The five remaining celebrities are deep in the heart of the African bush, and with rations running low, Bear challenges them to choose from a selection of edible flora. But while some is a vital source of sustenance, others could kill them. After this, expedition leader Meg Hine pretends to be seriously injured and losing blood. The celebrities have only 40 minutes to make a stretcher and carry her over scrubland to the extraction point. Can they make it before Meg `dies' of organ failure? Final.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: The celebrities move from the African bush to the coastal forest, where they must learn how to adapt to their new surroundings. Bear surprises the survivors by revealing they are camped only 30 feet away from three elephants - but their delight turns to disgust when they learn their first task - how to extract drinking fluid from the animals' dung to ensure survival in dire situations. They are then tasked with their first mission - to cross a canyon with a thumping waterfall and strong fast flowing water. As they bed down later, the mood within camp is strained and arguments begin.

And Lantern’s night shift recovery op Jason faces a battle to rescue an articulated lorry that’s crashed down a steep ditch off the A1.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: An overturned Gas tanker full of highly flammable propane mean trouble for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve. Working with the fire service he must all his experience to keep his team out of danger. Meanwhile with very little room to manoeuvre Lantern recovery op Steve must rescue a 44-ton artic stuck in a ditch on a busy five lane roundabout. And Lantern Recovery Op Sean has thought on his feet to break into an abandoned truck.

programme.title: David Attenborough A Life on Earth 第1季
programme.sub-title: David Attenborough: A Life on Earth
programme.desc: The incredible journey and illustrious career of one of the most travelled men in history, this documentary tells the story of how Sir David Attenborough came to be the voice of modern natural history programs by bringing the natural world into our homes.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: The five remaining celebrities are deep in the heart of the African bush, and with rations running low, Bear challenges them to choose from a selection of edible flora. But while some is a vital source of sustenance, others could kill them. After this, expedition leader Meg Hine pretends to be seriously injured and losing blood. The celebrities have only 40 minutes to make a stretcher and carry her over scrubland to the extraction point. Can they make it before Meg `dies' of organ failure? Final.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: The celebrities move from the African bush to the coastal forest, where they must learn how to adapt to their new surroundings. Bear surprises the survivors by revealing they are camped only 30 feet away from three elephants - but their delight turns to disgust when they learn their first task - how to extract drinking fluid from the animals' dung to ensure survival in dire situations. They are then tasked with their first mission - to cross a canyon with a thumping waterfall and strong fast flowing water. As they bed down later, the mood within camp is strained and arguments begin.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the South American country of Bolivia, Catfish and Rooftop put their bravery to the test. This duo goes 0 for 2 in the ring testing out their fight skills participating in traditional Tinku fighting and getting smacked down by Bolivia’s Fighting Cholitas. They also face a sketchy ride up death rode just to mountain bike down an equally dangerous path. Catfish has yet to keep a meal down as our bikers try llama brains and Rooftop nearly gets run over as a dancing zebra in the streets. The two top their Bolivian trip off with a trip to the mines on the hunt for silver. With some of the most dangerous activities yet, will Rooftop and Catfish be able to leave Bolivia with just a few bumps and bruises from along the way.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the most action packed trip yet, Rooftop and Catfish’s trip to Thailand has them face to face with the country’s nature. They wrestle a crocodile, charm a cobra, and get a massage from an elephant that’s somehow more relaxing than the traditional Thai massages they tried out. The two even attempt to catch (cooked) flying chickens on their heads. Things relaxed in Thailand for a moment when the BMX bikers got to balance out this animal packed experience with the spiritual side of the country, each getting Sak Yant, a traditional Thai tattoo. However, the relaxation was short-lived as Catfish and Rooftops’s final battle in Thailand requires them to make it out of a May Thai boxing match alive.

programme.category: Adventure, Nature, Enironment, Educational, Animation / nan

programme.desc: DiktaThor creates a homemade hair remover to overtake Bhilka. To beat DiktaThor, Sprinter needs help from a brave furless friend to save the day. But who could it be.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -超級粉絲
programme.desc: The official 'Sprinter Galore - fan club' wants to pay tribute to the superhero. A big party is planned, but when the villain Cleopatra turns out to be a member, the festivities suddenly become suspicious.

programme.desc: Kit is rusting in the toxic desert of the former Aral Sea.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -城市裡的水
programme.desc: Mr. Battery is flushed into the city's water pipeline and wastewater system.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -塞爾維亞之旅
programme.desc: Milo is thrilled to find a four-leaf clover and shows it to Alim, who eats it! Upset, Zoe and Milo follow Alim to Serbia, where Nevana invites them to a party with sports. They learn that Serbia has other lucky charms beyond the four-leaf clover.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -中非共和國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is grumpy about babysitting her little sister. Alim suggests Milo take over, but he protests, saying babysitting is a girl's job. Alim takes them to the Central African Republic, where Yamba shows that among the Aka, men care for babies.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -塞內加爾之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo show up with one baguette instead of two. When Alim suggests they could have bargained, Zoe and Milo refuse-bargaining isn't an option! Alim takes them to Senegal, where along with chasing chickens on bikes, bargaining is considered an art.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -伊朗之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo offer Alim a snack, but when he refuses, they eat it themselves. Alim protests-he was just being polite! To explain, Alim takes them to Iran to meet Aydin during Nowruz, where they learn about Ta'arof, the custom of refusing three times before accepting.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -困在泡泡裡
programme.desc: Doki shares Oto and Anabella's bubble-gum blowing pictures online. A friend of the Worldwide Expedition Club says it reminds him of the bubbles the worms make in New Zealand. Doki is amazed – why would a worm blow bubbles? The team set off to find out.

programme.title: 叢林樂節拍 -章魚--無法觸及
programme.desc: The octopus discovers a tasty mussel, but catching it turns out to be much more challenging than the octopus ever expected. His long tentacles are simply in the way. Welcome to the jungle where funny animals live and play.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -奇妙醫學和急救
programme.desc: What's the best way to organise a first aid kit? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of medicine. Have hands-on fun by making a handy first aid kit, and get to know Al-Zahrawi, ‘the father of surgery' & inventor of a number of surgical instruments.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -磁鐵的多項應用
programme.desc: How did people know where they were heading before GPS? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of magnetism. Have hands-on fun by constructing your own compass, and get to know An Wang, a computer engineer who revolutionised magnetic core memory.

programme.title: 44隻貓 -下兩天
programme.desc: Wrench involves the Buffycats in his 'Scrapyard Game', an outdoor activity calling the four cat friends to imagine themselves in fantasy scenarios and solve adventurous missions... all avoiding the heavy rain pouring outside.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波和新船
programme.desc: A new boat arrives and Bird makes a new friend Zoot, a tiny yellow canary who lives on the boat. They become inseparable. Grrrr. Then, one day, the new boat is gone along with Zoot. Bird pines. Ebb and Flo create a little gift to cheer Bird up.

programme.title: 百變小露露 -蝴蝶的蟲足
programme.desc: Luna, Jupiter, and Clyde follow a butterfly through the garden and notice her rubbing her feet on flowers. Curious about this strange behavior, the trio sets out to discover what the butterfly is really doing.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -在布蘭特福德很久很久以前
programme.desc: The kids team up with an old enemy to pull off an epic heist on the Historical Society. Tensions run high when someone is a no-show, making the group leave their comfort zone. Joy has to distract Miss Dumont while Raign battles with a rotary phone.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -艾多莉的「三千煩惱絲
programme.desc: Astoria panics because she wakes up in the library every morning. Rose and the others discover her ivy-hair is taking her there while she sleeps. They get a magical shampoo to cure it, but Astoria's hair is always one step ahead.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -騎士們

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -傻人節

programme.sub-title: 第七集：運動會當天狀況百出
programme.desc: 運動會當天，劉向上遇暴雨航班取消無法趕回，景婷婷熬綠豆湯時被燙傷，唐曉薇被堵在採購路上不能及時趕到，突發狀況此起彼伏。校門外班主任王老師告知，今年體育館內空間有限，每位學生只能有一位家長陪同.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 承接上集，戴祖儀跟羅啟豪這對一動一靜的新鮮組合，繼續與眾同樂。羅啟豪獻上自己的第一首國語歌曲《畫中密碼》，戴祖儀深情演繹《由他》，兩人更邀請粉絲上台玩遊戲，為《港樂．講樂》期間限定音樂會帶來熾熱氣氛.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第六集 - 鄭衍峰、周卓盈、黃明德｜千年智慧九連環誰能拆解？
programme.desc: 本季最後一集有星級嘉賓藝人鄭衍峰、體育舞蹈員周卓盈Tracy和歌手黃明德Dark。三位對不同類別的中華文化都有所認識，漢代發明、唐代官制、經典文學、新疆基建、地理知識的問題，他們又能否逐一解答？想不到安徽黃山宏村馬頭牆的功能竟會難倒一眾嘉賓！而互動題為大家帶來由古代時興至今的益智玩具「九連環」，設計巧妙、又蘊藏數學原理，要拆解更加考起手腦配合！最後誰夠心靈手巧，再憑豐富知識，贏得最後一集的中華知識王令牌呢？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：鄭衍峰、周卓盈、黃明德. #中華知識王2#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#鄭衍峰#周卓盈#黃明德#安徽黃山#宏村馬頭牆#九連環#紅樓夢.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集：顧嶼和林媛暗互生情愫
programme.desc: 林媛帶著蘇橙橙的祖母吃飯，顧嶼不請自來，蘇嫲嫲看出了顧嶼的小心思，戳破了兩個人之間曖昧的氛圍。另外，唐奇為了解開心中的疑惑，故意裝盲向蘇橙橙表示全勝唐死亡的場景重現能讓自己恢復視力，蘇橙橙信以為真，再次變身為唐奇進行治療，然而一切卻被唐奇看在眼中.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 維克托的極限清單2
programme.sub-title: 佛羅倫斯 古典足球
programme.desc: 在本集節目中，維克托遠赴意大利佛羅倫斯，探索一項傳奇運動——「古典足球」。這項源自十六世紀的傳統運動，至今只有佛羅倫斯仍然保留着；它揉合了足球、橄欖球及摔角的元素，被公認為全球最暴力的體育賽事之一。. 然而，維克托面臨著一個嚴苛的門檻：若想參與正式比賽，選手必須在佛羅倫斯出生。為了突破這項限制，維克托必須全力爭取在一場「紀念賽」中登場——這是一年一度、非聯賽性質的盛事，也是外人唯一能踏入比賽球場的機會。. 這是一次深入意大利傳統、榮譽與自豪的強烈體驗，維克托將帶領觀眾領略意大利的鬥士文化。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2026年5月5日 星期二 晚上10時. . In this episode, Victor Bergeon travels to Florence, Italy, to uncover the legendary sport known as calcio storico—a 16th century tradition that Florence alone still preserves today. A brutal fusion of football, rugby, and wrestling, calcio storico is widely regarded as one of the most violent sports in the world. . There is, however, a major obstacle: to play in an official match, competitors must have been born in Florence. To work around this restriction, Victor must fight for a place in a special commemorative game—a one off, non league event held each year that allows foreign participants and serves as his only gateway into the arena. . This is an intense journey into a world defined by tradition, honor, and pride, as Victor introduces us to the culture of Italy’s last remaining gladiators. . Bilingual: Cantonese / French (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2026.05.05 Tue, 10pm.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 一隻稀有的鳳凰啄木鳥喜歡了阿菇，整天停留在阿茹頭上，但阿菇對它沒有好感。英雄們決意把啄木鳥送回家，他們找到大白樺樹，樹上有很多蘑菇，看起來就像阿菇一樣，因此大家都肯定這就是鳳凰啄木鳥的家。然而，與此同時，他們即將要面對一隻住在樹裡的食人魔.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 幕別町的紅蘿蔔採用大規模產地獨有的方法收割，以承包商制度，由農協負責收割。農民準備的紅蘿蔔菜式給我們留下深刻印象.

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.sub-title: 第一集: 唐影和許子詮飛機上相遇
programme.desc: 北京飛往上海的飛機上，律師唐影偶遇了投行精英許子詮，彼此互留不好印象。唐影背了上司大王在合同上的黑鍋，還要繼續準備公司內部的競聘，身心疲倦。許子詮被上司施壓完成併購方案，否則就要被裁員。唐影的表妹林心姿因與男友鬧彆扭不請自來，在唐影哭訴男友的事情.

承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第六集：兩家會面因婚禮理念衝突
programme.desc: 辛麥兩家會面因婚禮理念衝突，辛家姐姐揶揄麥家，承歡怒斥可以不結婚。姚志明送禮卻被承歡男友誤會，承歡摘下求婚戒指離去。承歡媽媽為面子逼家人爭排場，與承歡爭執後欲找麥祖母添嫁妝。姚志明則暗示麥祖母委託興安里給承歡。這婚事能成嗎.

programme.title: 承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第七集：辛家欲借麥家搭上姚志明
programme.desc: 承歡媽媽誤以為姚志明是騙子，鬧出笑話。承歡拒絕母親催婚，祖母贈手鏈勸她追尋真心。姚志明欣賞承歡的責任感，約定共訪祖母，確認她不知祖母資產。承歡媽媽逼老公與辛家聯繫，辛家借麥家搭上姚志明，以此穩住生意。承歡的弟弟在職場受排擠，承歡會如何拆解以上問題.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 英雄們不滿快樂委員會卻只會坐著指揮別人，而自己則要從事吃力而又不討好的工作，於是他們向委員會發起挑戰，要求交換工作。委員會第一項任務，就是要阻止臭鼬打開裝滿臭臭黏液嘅臭臭之門；另一邊廂，英雄很快就發現管理的工作壓力有多大。最後，英雄們同意換回工作，拯救森林.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.desc: 景婷婷家中，三個女人一籌莫展地研究怎麼做南瓜燈。但孩子們並不開心，缺少了他們的參與這還是親子作業嗎？劉向上為果寧作業去找道具師傅，花五百元做紙箱機器人。作業算是交上了。媽媽們做南瓜燈失敗連連，直至剩下最後三個.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：唐奇心動蘇橙橙
programme.desc: 由蘇橙橙變身成的蘇渺制服了跟蹤唐奇的人。蘇渺緊張關心唐奇之際，卻發現唐奇其實沒有失明。蘇橙橙不得不向唐奇坦白並道歉自己一直欺騙了他，然而唐奇並未因此而生氣，卻在不自覺中關注蘇橙橙，意識到自己一直喜歡的都是蘇橙橙.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 埃塞俄比亞曾經發生過許多衝突和災難，留下了持久的恥辱，這也解釋了為甚麼這個地方甚少有遊客到訪。然而，這個國家擁有豐富的歷史和自然塊寶，可供那些好奇心旺盛的遊人探索。《細味埃塞俄比亞》將會帶你踏足這個國家北部的高原，那裡有讓人驚嘆的豐富文化、民族和精神寶藏。 昔日被稱為阿比西尼亞的埃塞俄比亞，是世界上最古老的國家之一。這個國家長期以來一直與世隔絕，但現在值得更多人認識。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年8月13日 星期二晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 「禾下乘涼夢」的理想正在喚醒沉睡的土地，讓希望在鹽鹼荒灘上綻放。在曾被視為「地球之癬」的鹽鹼荒灘上，科技讓稻穗滿滿，創新的技術亦守護「耕地中的大熊貓」。黑地煥發新生機，糧食安全的根基正隨著土地的治癒與日益豐饒而愈加牢固.

programme.sub-title: 凍能生巧 無電製冷技術(專利)
programme.desc: 一間源自本地大學實驗室的創科公司，致力發展一種無電製冷技術，三年間增長迅速，由最初的油漆塗料發展至地磚、薄膜以及紡織品等多樣化產品。. 本集將了解他們如何善用專利保護，為核心技術帶來穩妥保障，令公司科研發展之路可以走得更快更遠.

programme.desc: 埃塞俄比亞曾經發生過許多衝突和災難，留下了持久的恥辱，這也解釋了為甚麼這個地方甚少有遊客到訪。然而，這個國家擁有豐富的歷史和自然塊寶，可供那些好奇心旺盛的遊人探索。《細味埃塞俄比亞》將會帶你踏足這個國家北部的高原，那裡有讓人驚嘆的豐富文化、民族和精神寶藏。 昔日被稱為阿比西尼亞的埃塞俄比亞，是世界上最古老的國家之一。這個國家長期以來一直與世隔絕，但現在值得更多人認識。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年8月13日 星期二晚上10時30分.

香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: Lin Ma Hang: Half a Village
programme.desc: This episode delves into the remote village of Lin Ma Hang, exploring the deep emotional ties of its original inhabitants and the unique rhythm of life in this secluded place. Never abandoned despite its isolation, Lin Ma Hang is home to residents who have lived there for over 70 years. Many, after working in the city, maintain village homes and return as they age, drawn to their ancestral roots. The village hosts the Liu, Yip, and Koon clans, with the Yip surname dominant among permanent residents. Villagers credit the construction of roads and the International Bridge for the village’s survival, though the bridge was closed during the pandemic. Through Lin Ma Hang’s story, this episode showcases the enduring culture and resilience of one of Hong Kong’s rare rural communities, offering a window into its history and emotional bonds.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 安旎親自走訪詹梅家瞭解案情，決定繼續查惠權。安旎在朱辛殺妻案第二次開庭前再次建議朱辛承認控罪，並說出背後網路賭博的線索。安旎跟何陸源指出根據朱辛案得到的線索，結合了施小虎、張小北等不同受害者的情況，認為有一個更大的罪惡網.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 朱辛案件挖出的背後的網路賭博線索的追查卻陷入絕境，犯罪分子應該是一群有技術的高智商人群。詹梅的聽證案終於開庭了，安旎提出想要回施小虎帳號。安旎和李儀棠對於案件正面交鋒，李儀棠最終同意免於起訴程式、將施小虎的帳號給到詹梅.

programme.sub-title: 姜皓文/跑在黑暗找到愛
programme.desc: 〈跑者愛分享〉－姜皓文. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與姜皓文（黑哥）在將軍澳海濱盡情奔跑，黑哥分享他在跑步過程中的啟發：「不怕慢，只怕停！」這句話成為了他的生活格言。邀請大家一起踏出步伐，探索跑步的樂趣和堅持的力量！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－跑步慳力有秘訣？. 想跑得更輕鬆、更省力？原來正確跑姿是關鍵！從頭部姿勢、手臂擺動到腳步落地，每個細節都要相互配合，全面掌握正確跑姿，讓你輕鬆提升跑步效率，事半功倍！. 〈跑在黑暗找到愛〉. 傅提芬（Inti），是香港首名完成六大馬的視障跑手。面對黑暗，Inti選擇向前跑，與領跑員丈夫一起跑遍全世界。跑步，讓他們找到光明、找到愛.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈：薩爾斯堡音樂節: 卡普森與康特洛夫
programme.sub-title: 薩爾斯堡音樂節: 卡普森與康特洛夫
programme.desc: 小提琴家卡普森與鋼琴家康特洛夫，他們同樣來自法國，才華橫溢，並在多個國際獎項中屢獲殊榮，被譽為樂壇上一顆璀璨的明星。在今次音樂會上，他們攜手演繹布拉姆斯的三首小提琴與鋼琴奏鳴曲。演奏會在薩爾斯堡莫札特基金會的音樂大廳內舉行，這座音樂廳以其絕佳的音響效果見稱，被視為室內演奏會的理想舉行地點。. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2025年9月20日 星期六 下午3時30分 . French violinist Renaud Capuçon and French pianist Alexandre Kantorow, each of them a star in his own right and winners of many international awards, teamed up to play all three sonatas of Johannes Brahms for violin and piano. In the Great Hall of the Salzburg Mozarteum Foundation, ideally suited for the performance of chamber music. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2025.9.20 SAT 3:30pm.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台︰浪漫的啟示
programme.desc: 《演藝盛薈．開放舞台》為觀眾帶來多首為愛而生、環環相扣的浪漫時期室內樂作品。克拉拉及羅伯特·舒曼可謂音樂史上最著名的夫妻，而舒曼氏伉儷的作品更是他們的情書。這對戀人幾乎於每首作品中都把愛的密碼隱藏於音符之間。布魯赫（他的妻子亦名克拉拉）年幼時所跟隨的老師，恰巧亦是舒曼鋼協所贈之人。音樂會亦為觀眾呈獻魏恩齊爾於同一時期所撰寫的四中提琴夜曲，優雅動人。. 此演出由比爾斯飛躍演奏音樂節2022音樂家所演奏。各位音樂家從世界各地前往香港，參與2022年初的室內樂音樂節。可惜，音樂節因疫情關係而取消，音樂家將演奏錄影成為《演藝盛薈．開放舞台:浪漫的啓示》，繼續為觀眾呈獻美樂。. 音樂會片段由飛躍演奏香港錄製及提供。. 節目. 克拉拉・舒曼三首中提琴和鋼琴浪漫曲，作品22. 劉子正（中提琴）、張郁苓（鋼琴）. 布魯赫為小提琴、中提琴和鋼琴而寫的八首小品，作品83（選段）. 朱丹（小提琴）、李溢（中提琴）、王致仁（鋼琴）. 魏恩齊爾四中提琴夜曲，作品34. 凌顯祐（中提琴）、陳敏聰（中提琴）、李溢（中提琴）、劉子正（中提琴）. 舒曼降E大調鋼琴四重奏，作品47. 朱丹（小提琴）、劉子正（中提琴）、鮑力卓（大提琴）、左章（鋼琴.

雙城記-兩岸主播逛香港
programme.desc: 第二集《發現屯門》通過講述屯門的過去、現在，及未來的展望，來發現「不一樣的香港」。兩岸三地的主持人，與嘉賓一起搭上屯馬線及輕鐵，探訪屯門的宜居和交通便捷，同時還有連接內地的地理優勢。通過走訪掃管笏遺址、有「香港千島湖」之稱的大纜涌，屯門陶淵明後人聚居區——藍地等處，帶觀眾瞭解屯門名字的由來，以及過去在香港的地位和作用。而三聖邨，黃金海岸旅遊區、屯門公園、藝術新地標等地，則展現屯門有別於香港市區不同又獨具魅力的自然風光景色.

programme.title: 民生美食關注組
programme.desc: 今集主持阮頌陽（Brian）與林泳怡（Vicky）登上太平山，挑戰盧吉道環迴步行徑，提倡「先鍛鍊、後開餐」的美食哲學。節目內容精彩豐富：Brian 聯同澳洲網紅 Brendan 橫跨港九，品嚐老字號茶餐廳西餅與人氣煲仔飯；Vicky 則與美食博主 Stephen 深入慈雲山，發掘沙嗲牛煲仔麵及創意班蘭雞蛋仔等隱世滋味，帶觀眾從山頂俯瞰美景，再深入社區尋找地道與創新的火花.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
十二封信
programme.desc: 2026年，余念終於知曉撫養自己長大的「父親」就是唐亦尋。沈程寫信警告1991年的母親葉海棠遠離唐亦尋，稱他會帶來危險。但透過老師譚鑫之口，他們深信唐亦尋絕不會傷害葉海棠。1991年，收到警告信的二人陷入困惑，與未來的通信卻因郵筒消失而中斷。此時，黑道的威脅步步緊逼，唐亦尋三兄弟被迫接下危險的「最後一單」.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影：秋天的童話
programme.desc: 年輕貌美的十三妹(鍾楚紅飾)隻身遠赴美國和男友VINCENT (陳百強飾)一同讀書及生活。不料， VINCENT早已移情別戀，並決定與新女友 PEGGY (吳福星飾)移居波士頓。十三妹心灰意冷，開始自我封閉起來，什麼也不聞不問。某天，她險些吸入過量的煤氣身亡，幸得住在樓下的船頭尺(周潤發飾)及時相救才保著性命。在船頭尺的悉心照顧下，十三妹開始重拾自信，面對人生，而二人的關係亦因此變得微妙起來.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 「禾下乘涼夢」的理想正在喚醒沉睡的土地，讓希望在鹽鹼荒灘上綻放。在曾被視為「地球之癬」的鹽鹼荒灘上，科技讓稻穗滿滿，創新的技術亦守護「耕地中的大熊貓」。黑地煥發新生機，糧食安全的根基正隨著土地的治癒與日益豐饒而愈加牢固.

programme.title: 義工善行 公務員好故事
programme.desc: 義務工作為社會上有需要的群體帶來希望和光明，發放正能量。公務員事務局於2024年推出「公務員義工嘉許計劃」，以表揚參與或推動義工服務有卓越表現的公務員義工隊及同事，本集會介紹2025年「公務員義工嘉許計劃」的部份得獎義工團隊及獲頒個人獎項的公務員，當中包括：. 懲教署愛羣義工團（警衛犬隊分隊）－ 義工隊憑藉專業的犬隻訓練知識，與動物福利機構合作，每月定期協助訓練待領養犬隻基本禮儀及簡單指令，從而增加被領養的機會，並邀請不同青少年團體參加活動，希望以生命照亮生命，傳遞愛護動物及尊重生命的訊息。. 機電工程署義工隊－義工隊以專業的機電知識，為獨居或雙老長者更換慳電明亮的LED燈泡，並提供家居用電安全資訊和建議。換燈泡一個看似小小的舉動，長者可節省電費之餘，亦大大避免了潛在的家居危機，提升生活質素。.

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.sub-title: 姜皓文/跑在黑暗找到愛
programme.desc: 〈跑者愛分享〉－姜皓文. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與姜皓文（黑哥）在將軍澳海濱盡情奔跑，黑哥分享他在跑步過程中的啟發：「不怕慢，只怕停！」這句話成為了他的生活格言。邀請大家一起踏出步伐，探索跑步的樂趣和堅持的力量！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－跑步慳力有秘訣？. 想跑得更輕鬆、更省力？原來正確跑姿是關鍵！從頭部姿勢、手臂擺動到腳步落地，每個細節都要相互配合，全面掌握正確跑姿，讓你輕鬆提升跑步效率，事半功倍！. 〈跑在黑暗找到愛〉. 傅提芬（Inti），是香港首名完成六大馬的視障跑手。面對黑暗，Inti選擇向前跑，與領跑員丈夫一起跑遍全世界。跑步，讓他們找到光明、找到愛.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: Lin Ma Hang: Half a Village
programme.desc: This episode delves into the remote village of Lin Ma Hang, exploring the deep emotional ties of its original inhabitants and the unique rhythm of life in this secluded place. Never abandoned despite its isolation, Lin Ma Hang is home to residents who have lived there for over 70 years. Many, after working in the city, maintain village homes and return as they age, drawn to their ancestral roots. The village hosts the Liu, Yip, and Koon clans, with the Yip surname dominant among permanent residents. Villagers credit the construction of roads and the International Bridge for the village’s survival, though the bridge was closed during the pandemic. Through Lin Ma Hang’s story, this episode showcases the enduring culture and resilience of one of Hong Kong’s rare rural communities, offering a window into its history and emotional bonds.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 兩段不同香港旅行的回憶，都為餐廳主廚Balram Yadav及老闆Alex P.E.種下一個新的家。印度菜透過香料的搭配，突顯當中的色香味，例如奶油雞、脆餅(Dosa)，而南、北地區更衍生兩地飲食文化風情。Balram兒時受母親的耳濡目染下，就踏上了廚師之路，於多國工作的經驗令他一步一步在香港實現夢想。而Alex不忍多年心愛的飯堂結業，毅然接手餐廳，將素食文化傳承下去。同一地方，但為二人開展人生另一頁.

programme.title: 再登地球之巔
programme.desc: 6,500萬年前，歐亞板塊和印度板塊的碰撞形成了這顆星球上海拔最高、最年輕的自然地理單元----青藏高原。青藏高原的6,500萬年意味着什麼？沿着這把「時間之尺」，科學家們深入可可西里無人區，在崑崙山北麓18公里的剖面上探尋青藏高原的隆起之迷；在4,460米的海拔高度考古人類文明的印記。沿着「時間之尺」，科學家揭示青藏高原的過去、現在和未來.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 大家有沒有聽過「肺動脈高壓」？又稱為「心臟癌症」。根據數字，每100萬人中，約有15至50人患上，屬於極其凶險的罕見病，致命率高，達一半患者會在五年內死亡。不過，只要及早診斷治療，是有助增加存活率。本集請來專科醫生詳細解釋這疾病，更有患者分享患病的心路經歷和接受新療法的效果，加深大眾對肺動脈高壓的認識及關注。. 主持：主持：董光達醫生、鄭萃雯. 嘉賓：阮嘉駿醫生(香港先天性及結構性心臟病學會理事會成員/心臟科專科).

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今次會去北見市參觀菠菜。菠菜在北海道廣泛種植，在冷凍加工過後，不只冬天，現在一整年都可以吃到。以現時的技術，可以令你分不清新鮮和冷凍菠菜之間的分別.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 逸飛發明了智慧管家球球2.0，讓灶君感到強所未有的危機，唯恐球球2.0奪走自己的寵愛，灶君和球球2.0展開激烈角逐，沒想到灶君遭遇危機，危急時刻球球2.0舍生救助，灶君隨化解心結.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 莎莎無意間看到女兒日記，誤以為女兒說自己不是個可靠的好媽媽，灶君由此對莎莎展開了「完美媽媽」特訓，卻失敗，萬念俱灰的莎莎被女兒邀請聽自己的日記，原來是自己沒看完日記，媽媽雖然不完美但在女兒心裡是全世界最好的媽媽.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 菲菲和如福在三里屯意外撞壞了大周周的吉他。菲菲決定幫助大周周週實現登台演出的願望，如福們幫助修好吉他並做好造型。準備就緒後，大周周在菲菲的鼓勵下勇敢走上舞台.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 菲菲陪敦敦在景山放風箏，風箏斷線飛走了。菲菲召集如福侍衛隊尋找風箏。朝風製造颶風，將菲菲和風箏捲上天空。福珠激發出強大能量，保護了菲菲。菲菲在空中發現了萬春亭頂上的寶盒.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 守護天堂
programme.desc: 榮列世界新七大自然奇觀之一的伊瓜蘇瀑布，以其橫跨3公里的275條瀑布成為世界上最大規模的瀑布群。然而，在這個當前經濟蓬勃發展的地區，如何在保護這個生態瑰寶的同時，推動旅遊業發展？. 受惠於阿根廷和巴西建立的多個國家公園，這片瀑布位於一片擁有獨特生物多樣性的廣闊森林核心地帶。瀑布周邊棲息著約422種鳥類，包括色彩絢麗的鞭笞巨嘴鳥、於瀑布後方築巢的大黑雨燕，以及對森林再生至關重要的黑額鳴冠雉。除此之外，這片地區還有猴子、長鼻浣熊及南美小食蟻獸，以及南美僅存的貓科動物，例如威嚴的美洲豹及敏捷的美洲獅。每年該地區接待超過300萬名遊客，為了把人類對動物的影響降至最低，遊客只能進入保護區的小部分地方。科學家和森林管理員不斷努力，保護動物免受偷獵的威脅，並教育當地居民如何與貓科動物和諧共處。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年5月20日 星期二 晚上10時. . The Iguazu Falls, one of the 7 wonders of the planet, are the biggest in the world with their 275 cascades on 3 kilometers. But, how to reconcile today this ecological treasure with the development of tourism, in a region in full economic boom?. Thanks to the creation of several national parks in Argentina and Brazil, they are in the heart of a vast forest with unique biodiversity. The area of the falls is home to 422 species of birds, from the majestic toucans to the great dusky swifts, which nest behind the falls, or the grey-fronted guans, essential for the regeneration of the forest. . In addition to populations of monkeys, coatis, and tamanduas, the region is also home to some of the last felines in South America, including the majestic jaguar or the agile puma. The site receives more than 3 million tourists per year. To minimize their impact on the fauna, they only have access to a small part of the protected area. Scientists and rangers are fighting relentlessly to protect the fauna from poaching and to educate the local population to live together with the felines. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.05.20 TUE 10pm.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: In 2024, the government introduced a regulatory scheme for “Basic Housing Units.” The standards and guidelines require features such as independently partitioned toilets and set ventilation requirements. The new rules aim to raise living standards and provide low‑income families with a safe and reasonably habitable environment. In this episode, we will explore with you.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.desc: 元宵節是中國民間傳統節日，隨著社會和時代變遷，元宵節的風俗習慣雖然有相當大程度的變化，但仍受到世代重視。活動由九龍樂善堂主辦，展示轄屬中小學及幼稚園學生的藝術作品。學生透過不同藝術品，如繪畫、素描、手工藝、綵燈形式，呈現「一元復始，大地回春」，共賀新春.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 老店情未了第二季 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Grande Dame of the Far East: Majestic Makeover
programme.desc: In 1970, 42 years after the opening of the hotel, its management was in the hands of Baron Lawrence Kadoorie and Sir Michael Kadoorie of the establishment’s founding family. With father and son both being avid car enthusiasts, a decision was made to introduce a limousine fleet. . The more famous the hotel became, the more VIPs stayed there. To cope with the increasing number of guests, it was necessary to extend the original 6-storey building. The works for adding a 30-storey new wing to the north tower then commenced in 1991 to include a rooftop restaurant, spa, and other modern facilities. A helipad was even put in place, making the hotel accessible by land, sea, and air.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 根據取得的施小虎遊戲帳號，檢察院和公安方面發現了施小虎可能認識張小北，以及眾多大學生有類似網貸情況的事實，直指可能網貸已經深入校園。安旎和何陸源深入大學調查取證並獲得關鍵線索，意識到惠權遊戲也在大學蔓延.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 安旎再次提審723案件的犯人李全，供出誰是真的老A。政法委組織各部門聯席會議，要求對非法網貸的深入調查。檢察院對近期頻受爭議的惠權遊戲作出《檢察建議書》，法務部的李儀棠和羅江孝連夜自查自糾，對公眾作出願意整改產品的聲明.

programme.desc: 元宵節是中國民間傳統節日，隨著社會和時代變遷，元宵節的風俗習慣雖然有相當大程度的變化，但仍受到世代重視。活動由九龍樂善堂主辦，展示轄屬中小學及幼稚園學生的藝術作品。學生透過不同藝術品，如繪畫、素描、手工藝、綵燈形式，呈現「一元復始，大地回春」，共賀新春.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 中國歷史上，每逢亂世苛政，總有人落草為寇、揭竿而起。從陳勝吳廣到李自成，從梁山好漢到太平天國，他們或被視為盜賊匪徒，或被尊為義士英雄，亦正亦邪之間，折射出底層百姓的苦難與抗爭，本集將探討草莽人物在史書與文學中截然不同的面貌。. 主持. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 謝偉傑(香港中文大學歷史系副教授). 吳海傑(香港大學法律學院教授及副院長(研究).

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第二集結伴跑. 〈跑者愛分享〉－蔡一智. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與蔡一智（智哥）在大潭水務文物徑暢跑，享受雨後清新的大自然氣息！智哥熱愛運動，深信「健康，就是送給家人最好的禮物」。他以自身經驗鼓勵大家及早儲備健康資本，跑出快樂、跑出健康！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－「超慢跑」有幾慢？. 近年流行的「超慢跑」，是一種低強度且輕鬆自在的有氧運動方式，速度介於步行與慢跑之間，有效降低關節負擔。這種跑步方式不僅適合不同年齡群組，更是初學者友善的入門運動，在家也能輕鬆練習，隨時隨地開啟健康之旅！. 〈結伴跑〉. 長跑運動員黃啟樂，自中學時受恩師啟蒙，踏上跑步旅程。一路奔跑，他在不同階段遇到許多生命中的良師益友，與及互相支持的另一半映潮。從校園操場到競技跑道，從跑步愛好者到專業運動員兼教練，每次結伴同行的經歷都給他帶來了深刻的啟發與成長.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：粵劇 牡丹亭驚夢
programme.sub-title: 粵劇 牡丹亭驚夢 (上集)
programme.desc: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：粵劇牡丹亭驚夢(上集). 《牡丹亭驚夢》是著名劇作家唐滌生，改編傳統崑劇《牡丹亭》而成的粵劇。. 故事講述宋朝太守之女杜麗娘在牡丹亭夢到書生柳夢梅而相戀，麗娘醒後思憶成疾而死，. 後來麗娘回生與夢梅結為夫婦，怎料不為麗娘父親杜寶認可，最後在皇帝調停下終能團圓。. 著名粵劇演員龍貫天與多位粵劇界年青新星傾力演出，配合全新舞台佈景燈光設計，展現. 粵劇美學新境界。. 粵劇片段由香港粵劇藝術團提供。. 表演者：. 龍貫天飾皇帝. 黃成彬飾柳夢梅. 劉麗飾杜麗娘. 梁煒康飾陳最良. 黎耀威飾杜寶. 吳敏婷飾春香.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 唱作歌手李靖筠(Gladys)近年嘗試R&B慵懶風格，同樣身為唱作人的布志綸(Alan)，作品就揉合搖滾、抒情，風格多變。兩位將同時上《港樂．講樂》的舞台現場演唱最新派台歌，更會一齊大玩遊戲！. 主持. 阮頌陽. 歌曲：. 李靖筠《最好比我更懶》. 布志綸《貼哋.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 有小鄰居覺得媽媽不但在網上處處監察自己，還沒收手機，害他失去「通訊自由」，所以急急地向Harry哥哥求救。可是，貓頭鷹博士根據《基本法》第三十條，認為事情未必如他所想。到底小鄰居是否有所誤會？而媽媽這樣做又是否另有原因呢？. 《基本法》第三十條：. 香港居民的通訊自由和通訊秘密受法律的保護。除因公共安全和追查刑事犯罪的需要，由有關機關依照法律程序對通訊進行檢查外，任何部門或個人不得以任何理由侵犯居民的通訊自由和通訊秘密。. . 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 將廣闊國土上的陽光、勁風與江河之力轉化為驅動未來的綠色動能，用沙漠陽光點亮萬家燈火，讓工廠流淌綠色電流。當「啟航號」風車的巨臂劃破長空，捕獲大自然之力，加上「零碳」工廠在黑暗中高效運轉，我們看見清潔能源正在重塑中國製造的基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 「IP 經濟」指知識產權（Intellectual Property）的商業化應用，是一種將原創動漫角色、故事等轉化為商品、授權等的商業模式。香港一家創意工作室，多年來透過取得版權授權，舉辦眾多深受市民大眾歡迎的展覽和活動。. 本集將從「超級聯繫人」及被授權方的角度，了解更多對知識產權保護的重要性，及探討香港發展「IP 經濟」的潛力和經濟影響.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星晴》循著藏曆的時間韻律，講述高原上與星空交織的追夢傳奇。 90後自由術家安念初紮根西藏十年，將納木措銀河凝於筆端，以3D壁畫喚醒恰村活力，讓藝術成為鄉村振興，文旅融合的星火.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 母親節是一個表達感謝和愛意的時刻。無論是你的媽媽、岳母、外婆還是任何其他特別的母親，許多人都會在母親節送一份有心思的禮物讓對方感到幸福與專屬。世界各地的母親節的日期有所不同，香港的母親節就是每年五月第二個周日。韓國沒有母親節也沒有父親節，他們將5月8日定為「父母節」，印尼母親節是每年12月22日，各地都有不同的慶祝方式。.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
十二封信
programme.desc: 2026年，唐亦尋的兄弟「耗子」現身，講述當年悲劇真相。1991年，三兄弟為家人鋌而走險執行「最後一單」，卻發現所謂的「貨物」竟是遭綁架的同學沈曉軍。黑道欲放火燒死二人並嫁禍，危急時刻，葉海棠衝入火場救出唐亦尋和沈曉軍，自己卻留下傷疤。員警趕到，真相大白，但三兄弟的命運已被改寫.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影 : 海外特派員
programme.desc: At the beginning of 1939, Jones, an American reporter, is sent by his paper to Europe. There, he is to investigate the possibility of a world war. In London, he meets an elderly Dutch politician, co-signatory of a secret alliance treaty whose details the Nazis will stop at nothing to discover. The old man is kidnapped.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: In 2024, the government introduced a regulatory scheme for “Basic Housing Units.” The standards and guidelines require features such as independently partitioned toilets and set ventilation requirements. The new rules aim to raise living standards and provide low‑income families with a safe and reasonably habitable environment. In this episode, we will explore with you.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 老店情未了第二季 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Grande Dame of the Far East: Majestic Makeover
programme.desc: In 1970, 42 years after the opening of the hotel, its management was in the hands of Baron Lawrence Kadoorie and Sir Michael Kadoorie of the establishment’s founding family. With father and son both being avid car enthusiasts, a decision was made to introduce a limousine fleet. . The more famous the hotel became, the more VIPs stayed there. To cope with the increasing number of guests, it was necessary to extend the original 6-storey building. The works for adding a 30-storey new wing to the north tower then commenced in 1991 to include a rooftop restaurant, spa, and other modern facilities. A helipad was even put in place, making the hotel accessible by land, sea, and air.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 守護天堂
programme.desc: 榮列世界新七大自然奇觀之一的伊瓜蘇瀑布，以其橫跨3公里的275條瀑布成為世界上最大規模的瀑布群。然而，在這個當前經濟蓬勃發展的地區，如何在保護這個生態瑰寶的同時，推動旅遊業發展？. 受惠於阿根廷和巴西建立的多個國家公園，這片瀑布位於一片擁有獨特生物多樣性的廣闊森林核心地帶。瀑布周邊棲息著約422種鳥類，包括色彩絢麗的鞭笞巨嘴鳥、於瀑布後方築巢的大黑雨燕，以及對森林再生至關重要的黑額鳴冠雉。除此之外，這片地區還有猴子、長鼻浣熊及南美小食蟻獸，以及南美僅存的貓科動物，例如威嚴的美洲豹及敏捷的美洲獅。每年該地區接待超過300萬名遊客，為了把人類對動物的影響降至最低，遊客只能進入保護區的小部分地方。科學家和森林管理員不斷努力，保護動物免受偷獵的威脅，並教育當地居民如何與貓科動物和諧共處。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年5月20日 星期二 晚上10時. . The Iguazu Falls, one of the 7 wonders of the planet, are the biggest in the world with their 275 cascades on 3 kilometers. But, how to reconcile today this ecological treasure with the development of tourism, in a region in full economic boom?. Thanks to the creation of several national parks in Argentina and Brazil, they are in the heart of a vast forest with unique biodiversity. The area of the falls is home to 422 species of birds, from the majestic toucans to the great dusky swifts, which nest behind the falls, or the grey-fronted guans, essential for the regeneration of the forest. . In addition to populations of monkeys, coatis, and tamanduas, the region is also home to some of the last felines in South America, including the majestic jaguar or the agile puma. The site receives more than 3 million tourists per year. To minimize their impact on the fauna, they only have access to a small part of the protected area. Scientists and rangers are fighting relentlessly to protect the fauna from poaching and to educate the local population to live together with the felines. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.05.20 TUE 10pm.

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.sub-title: 第四集: 孤獨的鯨魚
programme.desc: 唐影的表妹林心姿失戀後在公園散步，遇到了馬其遠，以為他是成熟幽默並且富裕。馬其遠邀請林心姿共進晚餐，林心姿發現期望與實際情況有落差。許子詮和唐影兩家公司處理同一客戶，共同工作時二人的心逐漸拉近。另外，徐家柏繼續以殷勤打動林心姿.

programme.sub-title: 第十二集：三人去郊區酒店散心
programme.desc: 承歡父母擔心承歡失戀的心情，麥爸請祖母幫忙開導承歡，承歡在祖母的鼓舞下振作。祖母、承歡及姚志明三人去郊區新開發的酒店散心及參觀，承歡及姚志明兩人一路吵吵鬧鬧。承歡看出酒店存在不少問題，提出加強員工培訓，但姚志明竟打算更換整個團隊.

programme.title: 承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第十三集：姚志明提醒承歡遠離辛家紛爭
programme.desc: 承歡及姚志明在酒店度假後認識加深。承歡發現辛爸的婚外情，她拒絕封口費，並專注工作。姚志明提醒她遠離辛家紛爭。麥家水管爆裂，承歡姊弟共同收拾家中殘局，兩人看到媽媽早年買的玩具，體會到母親的用心。麥家因為泡水受損嚴重，麥家會如何處理.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 英雄們墮入陷阱，參與「年度冒險者比賽」。事實上，這場由哥布林偽造的競賽，目的是讓英雄們彼此對抗，籍此分散他們的注意，令哥布林可以趁機偷走鬆餅。不過，英雄們很發現真相，齊心協力逃脫，並踏上拯救森林與鬆餅庫的旅程.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今次會去學習鄂霍次克地區小清水町的牛蒡種植。這是一片旱田農業與酪農業皆發展蓮勃的地區，而處理土壤的技術亦令人驚嘆。我們學習如何人手掘牛蒡，並觀察如果用機器收割。其後亦品嚐了農民烹調的牛蒡菜式.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：嫲嫲無微不至的照顧
programme.desc: 保姆不慎忘記接初一放學，景婷婷終於爆發。景婷婷辭退保姆的同時，也為其過往經歷動容。劉向上回家看見家裏一片狼藉，果寧和果寶各自玩着手機平板吃着零食。劉向上要求倆人收拾屋子，張文萍卻讓倆孩子玩，她來收拾.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 多元族裔人士要尋找工作一向不容易，如學歷不高、言語不通，可以選擇的工種未必會很多，加上文化差異，在職場亦可能會感到壓力。今集主持Wimmy 和主持成家宏會和巴基斯坦裔的阿文Minhas Rashad，大家一齊食零食、傾下計，暢談多元族裔人士在香港生活的工作的現況.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 本集帶你越過南北之分，尋找隱身香港的河內家鄉味。店主Kenny與Julie堅持小店用心，每週親手空運食材、甚至搬運越南擺設回港，只為重現最地道的北越風情，例如河內牛柳粉和米紙卷。這裡沒有宣傳攻勢，卻有熟客為他們寫文拍片、首飾店主動提出聯乘。一碗湯粉背後，是兩個香港人對越南味道的執著，與食客結下的真摯緣分.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 鹽分兩面睇
programme.desc: 鹽是珍貴的物資，對我們的生存至關重要。但這種「白色黃金」是否已構成對地球末來的威脅？ 世界各地的科學家對鹽化問題日益關注。這個現象對全球珍貴的淡水儲備有甚麼影響？ 鹽擁有非凡的潛力及多樣性，然而，隨著大海的鹹水不斷侵蝕沿岸土地，鹽掛上污染地下水和破壞農牧業的污名。大眾開始警覺鹽對他們的生活、生計，及文化都會大受威脅。 然而，近年有人研究利用鹽來儲電或用於建築用途。本集節目揭示鹽的力量密碼，細訴鹽如何改變綠色能源生產，開闢通往永續建築材料的道路。. Salt – precious and essential for survival. But has this white gold also become a threat to the future of our planet?. Scientists around the world are growing increasingly concerned about salinization. What does this mean for the world's precious freshwater reserves? With its incredible versatility and potential, however, salt also emerges as a promising protagonist of a greener tomorrow. Join us as we unlock the secrets of salt's power to revolutionize green energy production and forge a path towards sustainable building materials.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星晴》循著藏曆的時間韻律，講述高原上與星空交織的追夢傳奇。 90後自由術家安念初紮根西藏十年，將納木措銀河凝於筆端，以3D壁畫喚醒恰村活力，讓藝術成為鄉村振興，文旅融合的星火.

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 唐影和許子詮一起晚餐，發現彼此如此志趣相投，但大家說只可做朋友。醉後許子詮給唐影買了一份禮物，一對戒指. .。第二天，唐影看到許子詮與另一位女性喝咖啡的畫面，感到一絲失落。唐影的客戶劉美玲想當紅娘，介紹好友章以文給唐影認識.

承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：辛爸中風住院
programme.desc: 姚志明暗助承歡獲住戶表彰。第三者逼婚失敗，辛爸中風住院，承歡收到求救電話，在姚志明陪同下趕往醫院簽字救人卻遭辛家誤解。姚志明保護承歡，承歡為感激姚志明的解圍請他去吃飯。承歡能否擺脫辛家糾葛，迎來新轉機.

programme.title: 承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第十五集：承歡男友求複合
programme.desc: 承歡男友求複合被拒。麥家受損嚴重，承歡媽媽催承歡與男友複合脫困。承歡弟弟隱瞞辭職送外賣，承歡心疼弟弟，有些後悔拒絕高薪工作機會。弟弟卻支持姐姐的選擇，表示姐弟同心。辛姐設計約承歡媽媽出來看婚房，勸說她撮合承歡與辛家亮複合。承歡會否再次陷入辛家算計.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 赫伯特在白樺樹挖掘隧道，以便隨時拜訪朋友，然而這令其他英雄覺得赫伯持冒犯了他們的私人空間。為了逃避赫伯特的突然造訪，他們悄悄地逃去執行任務。不過，幾位英雄很快意識到，他們需要園藝專家赫伯特，來安撫一株憤怒的爬行植物.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 在仁木町學習香印提子的知識，當中的LaLa Shine還是初次面世。如此高級是有原因的！如此美味是有原因的！看看驚人的種植方法，實在是太精妙了.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第十二集：唐曉薇直播間人氣高漲
programme.desc: 果寧偷玩電腦被發現，引發一場雞飛狗跳。唐曉薇直播間人氣高漲，原來是馬英傑和糖豆聯合起來為直播間刷禮物、加業績。果寧向果寶借平板無果後，跑去唐曉薇家玩遊戲。劉向上發現後決定把遊戲刪了，卻把自己之前改的密碼忘記了.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 「沒有歌，怎敢說心事」，一首好的作品除了要有動聽的旋律外，亦要歌手動人的演繹，才能成為經典作品。歌手們日常用聲限制，又要戒吃辣，小心用聲，都只想將動聽作品送給各位樂迷。今集「實力唱將」系列精選多首實力歌手之作，讓大家可以再三回味他們的演出。. 主持. 阮頌陽.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 維克托的極限清單2
programme.sub-title: 蘇格蘭 高地運動會
programme.desc: 在蘇格蘭「高地運動會」絕非只是魁梧大力士在草地上角力的比賽，更是一場歷史悠久的文化慶典。. 在氏族征戰的歲月，體能是生存的重要門檻。早期的氏族首領透過投擲比賽，選拔精銳的勇士。時至今日，這種選拔方式已轉化為每年五至八月的年度盛事。每年夏天，蘇格蘭高地各社區都會舉辦專屬的高地運動會，穿上蘇格蘭裙的選手們，透過舉石、擲鐵鎚、拋木柱等項目，彼此較勁，在承傳著傳統之餘，也是身分認同與團結的展現。. 在這次旅程，維克托走訪高地運動會和世界大力士大賽的選手們，並在他們的指導下，親身挑戰在蘇格蘭著名的「延文禮士高地運動會」。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2026年5月12日 星期二 晚上10時. . The Scottish Highland Games are far more than a mere display of brute strength or a collection of athletic competitions. They are a profound celebration of the area’s storied history and cultural heritage. In an era when a warrior’s physical prowess was a matter of survival, clan chieftains used these tests of strength and skill to identify, recruit, and train the finest fighters in the land. . Today, this tradition thrives from May through August as communities across the Highlands host their own games. Athletes, clad in traditional kilts, compete in iconic events such as the stone put, hammer throw, and the legendary caber toss, pushing the boundaries of human power. . In this journey, Victor connects with elite athletes from the Highland Games and the World’s Strongest Man circuit. Mentored by these titans of strength, he steps into the arena to personally take on the challenge of Scotland’s prestigious Inverness Highland Games. . Bilingual: Cantonese / French (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2026.05.12 Tue, 10pm.

programme.title: 香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康
programme.desc: Mushrooms are nutritious and helps to reduce fat, defecate and improve dry skin. However, some people are scared of mushrooms. They are the gout patients. People generally think that mushrooms are high-purine food, and many of them are afraid that mushrooms will increase the risk of gout attacks. Is there any ground for such saying? In this episode of “Eat Well Live Well”, we will unveil the truth about mushrooms! The two “Food Fanatic” visit the organic mushroom farm of Hong Kong. This special mushroom farm was converted from recycled containers, thus allowing for effective control of temperature and humidity. The farm produces some species which are less common in Hong Kong, and the “Food Fanatic” also learn how to pick mushrooms. . The chef host Andy is good at Western cooking. This time, he will make a Hungarian assorted mushroom soup with different types of mushrooms, and share it with Rheumatologist Dr Carrel YU. Dr YU will explain while eating the causes of gout, the relationship between gout and purine, as well as debunk the myths about purine content in mushrooms amongst the public. . Hosts: Yuki LAW, Andy Dark (Chef). Guest: Dr Carrel YU (Rheumatologist/Specialist in Internal Medicine).

programme.title: 相會雙城
programme.sub-title: 相會雙城 - 咫尺之情 (上)
programme.desc: 這是一個跨越七十年的故事：相會於上海與香港之間，亦連繫着家鄉寧波奉化的記憶與溫度的延續。. 五十年代初，上海解放後，很多人帶着資金及技術湧入香港，當時26歲的張子斌在上海學得一手紅幫裁縫技藝，為了生計，他帶着僅有的十元美金，飄洋過海前往香港打拼。張子斌在香港落地生根，開設男士定制服裝店Ascot Chang，以穩妥的品質建立口碑，也為日後的傳承奠定根基。. 後來，張子斌身體抱恙，召回留學美國、剛剛大學畢業的兒子張宗琪（Tony）協助經營。原本對裁縫一竅不通的Tony，一做便做了四十多年，他秉承爸爸對品質的堅持、技術的追求，緊緊追隨爸爸的足跡。. 當內地改革開放帶來新機遇，九十年代Tony回到父親學藝及安居立業的上海，開設內地第一間分店，希望把家族事業帶到更廣闊的地方。同時，他亦延續爸爸回饋家鄉的善行，在寧波奉化為鄉鎮的小學捐錢興建新教學樓。. 為了拉近下一代與家鄉的距離，Tony安排兒子張奕庭（Justin）到農村小學當小老師，教授英文，讓Justin在日常相處中理解回鄉的意義。近年，他又以修葺祖墳作為起點，希望家族可以有一個回來聚首的地方。這份相會不只停留在上海與香港，更在寧波奉化的土地上，延續成一種長久的連結.

programme.title: 香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康
programme.sub-title: #10 Honey: A Taste of Nature’s Sweetness
programme.desc: With a mild taste, honey is the natural syrup endowed on us by the nature. It is said that in terms of blood glucose control, honey is better than ordinary sugar because of its natural ingredients. But is this true? In this episode of “Eat Well Live Well”, we will explore the nutritional value of honey. The two “Food Fanatic” visit a bee master to learn about the process and difficulties of beekeeping, and have a taste of the fresh and delicious honey from the honeycomb on the spot. . Hong Kong people love honey. Apart from honey water, honey is most commonly used for seasoning in barbecues. This time, Chef Will will make a dish “ Honeyed Chicken Wing Dumplings with Honey-Roasted Sweet Potatoes”; and Specialist in Endocrinology, Diabetes and Metabolism Dr Rose TING, and artiste Deon CHEUNG are invited to share their thoughts while enjoying the delicious food. Being middle-aged, Deon CHEUNG is particularly concerned about diet. What health preservation tips does he have? There is a saying amongst the public that honey is a boon to diabetics. Is this true? Let’s see what Dr TING says. . Hosts: Snowy CHOI, Will LEUNG (Chef). Guests: Deon CHEUNG, Dr Rose TING (Specialist in Endocrinology, Diabetes and Metabolism).

programme.title: 香港奇則 3
programme.desc: 今集兩個由香港人創造的奇則，兩個都被外國人讚嘆及認同。鹽田梓，一個消失了百年的鹽田，在冇圖則、冇人試過曬鹽的情況下，如何將鹽田重現而成為香港碩果僅存嘅產鹽地？香港因為土地問題，令天橋底這種閒置土地能夠提升地位，成為一個社區教育中心，天橋底在建築上限制.

programme.desc: 本集Ricky把凱撒沙律玩出了新高度，巧妙利用巴馬火腿捲起羅馬生菜，將沙律提升至法式餐點的水準。Jacky 則帶來極致開胃的番茄菠蘿酸湯泡飯，菠蘿與酸菜的完美組合，讓湯頭變得鮮甜又開胃，每一口泡飯都浸透了酸爽的湯汁，打造出一道鮮香微酸、層次分明的暖胃.

programme.title: 健康關注組
programme.desc: 幽門螺旋菌感染非常常見，估計香港有大約285萬人已經受到感染。而最近有研究指出，感染幽門螺旋菌會令焦慮症風險增加1.5倍，而焦慮症又會令腸胃問題惡化，形成惡性循環，今集主題：「感染幽門螺旋菌，腸胃受罪，情緒失控？」就由腸胃肝臟科專科醫生與精神科專科醫.
